personalityTraitOptions.description: I see omens in every event and action. The Force tries to speak to us, we just need to listen.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation. I never raise my voice or let my emotions control me.
The Force has chosen me for a greater purpose.  I am destined for greatness.
I would rather make a new friend than a new enemy. We are all connected to each other.
I've always been good at everything and things come to me naturally, but I am proud of my accomplishments.
I don�t pay attention to the risks in a situation. The odds are always in my favor.
The best way to get me to do something is to tell me I can�t do it.
My emotions sometimes get the most of me, but they help me succeed.

idealOptions.name: Dilligence
idealOptions.description: I seek to prove myself worthy of the Force by matching my actions against the Jedi teachings. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Change
idealOptions.description: We must help bring about the changes the Force is constantly working in the world. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Redemption
idealOptions.description: There's a spark of good in everyone. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Power
idealOptions.description: I will do whatever it takes to have power. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Faith
idealOptions.description: I trust that the Force will guide my actions; I have faith that if I work hard, things will go well. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Growth
idealOptions.description: Self-improvement is an unending chore, but one that must be done. (Any)

flawOptions.description: My faith in the Force sometimes leads me to blindly trust others that profess that same faith.
The Jedi and Sith worship the Force as a religion. I think they are idiots for worshipping a hammer.
I'm convinced of the significance of my destiny, and blind to my shortcomings and the risk of failure.
I have trouble trusting in my allies that don't share my connection to the Force.
I remember every insult I've received and nurse a silent resentment toward anyone who's ever wronged me.
Once I pick a goal, I become obsessed with it to the detriment of everything else in my life.

bondOptions.description: I'm searching for instruction in the ways of the Force.
I am fully dedicated to the will of the Force.  It leads and I follow.
I must return a relic to the temple it was taken from.
I will become the greatest user of the Force that ever lived.
I�m guilty of a terrible crime. I hope I can redeem myself for it.
Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made. That will never happen again.

backgrounds.name: Gambler
backgrounds.flavorText: You are a skilled gambler who spends most of your time in casinos, bar rooms, and gambling dens. Are your activities legal, or do you break the law? Have you ever cheated in a game, or do you play by the rules? No matter what, your life has been one of excitement, chance, and danger.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Insight, Intimidation, and Sleight of Hand
backgrounds.equipment: A set of common clothes, a set of dice, a deck of playing cards, a lucky charm, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr.
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Gambling is your passion, for better or for worse. Most gamblers see their vices as virtues, and overlook things in their pursuit of the rush.
backgrounds.featureText: You can convince nearly anyone to put up something they aren't normally willing to part with (property or information) in a game of chance. Your GM might rule that they will only agree to a game of their choosing, and they may only agree if they feel the odds are in their favor.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I like to impress everyone I meet with a simple trick or a quick joke.
I constantly make side bets on everything that happens around me.
No matter how high the stakes, I always appear calm.
I try to be unpredictable, so no one will know when I'm bluffing.
I never back down from a challenge.
I can't get satisfaction out of something if the stakes are too low.
I tend to make friends out of enemies, and enemies out of friends.
I prefer one game above all others.

idealOptions.name: Risk
idealOptions.description: Nothing worth doing is ever a sure thing. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Victory
idealOptions.description: Never make a bet unless you're sure you can win. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: Anything that isn't mine soon will be. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Charity
idealOptions.description: I share my winnings with the less fortunate. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Surprise
idealOptions.description: Life is a game worth playing, because you never know how the dice will land. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Laziness
idealOptions.description: Working is for chumps. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I can't step away from the table when I'm losing.
I spend money faster than I can make it.
Everyone has a price. Mine happens to be pretty low.
I assume everyone is hiding something from me.
I tend to value money more than people.
I like to think I could drink anyone under the table, but I'm really a lightweight.

bondOptions.description: I owe a lot of money to the wrong kind of people.
I still keep the first coin I ever won. It's my good luck charm.
Most of my winnings go to my home.
Someday I will own my own casino.
I lost a large sum of money to a con artist; I seek to get it back.
I hide my gambling behind a normal life. My friends have no idea who I really am.

backgrounds.name: Investigator
backgrounds.flavorText: Rarer than watch or patrol members are a community's investigators, who are responsible for solving crimes after the fact. Though such folk are seldom found in rural areas, nearly every settlement of decent size has at least one or two watch members who have the skill to investigate crime scenes and track down criminals.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Investigation, Perception, and Survival
backgrounds.equipment: A uniform in the style of your unit and indicative of your rank, a horn with which to summon help, a set of binders, and a pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Years of service in the City Watch have led to the rigid discipline most often seen in military service. Working with your comrades has created a strong family bond and pride in your community.
backgrounds.featureText: Your experience in enforcing the law, and dealing with lawbreakers, gives you a feel for local laws and criminals. You can easily find the local outpost of the watch or a similar organization, and just as easily pick out the dens of criminal activity in a community, although you're more likely to be welcome in the former locations rather than the latter.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I'm always polite and respectful.
I'm haunted by memories of war. I can't get the images of violence out of my mind.
I've lost too many friends, and I'm slow to make new ones.
I'm full of inspiring and cautionary tales from my guard service relevant to almost every combat situation.
I can stare down a hell hound without flinching.
I enjoy being strong and like breaking things.
I have a crude sense of humor.
I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success.

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: Our lot is to lay down our lives in defense of others. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Responsibility
idealOptions.description: I do what I must and obey just authority. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Independence
idealOptions.description: When people follow orders blindly, they embrace a kind of tyranny. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: In life as in war, the stronger force wins. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: Ideals aren't worth killing over or going to war for. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Nation
idealOptions.description: My city, nation, or people are all that matter. (Any)

flawOptions.description: The monstrous enemy we faced in battle still leaves me quivering with fear.
I have little respect for anyone who is not a proven warrior.
I made a terrible mistake in battle that cost many lives, and I would do anything to keep that mistake secret.
My hatred of my enemies is blind and unreasoning.
I obey the law, even if the law causes misery.
I'd rather eat my armor than admit when I'm wrong.

bondOptions.description: I would still lay down my life for the people I served with.
Someone saved my life on the battlefield. To this day, I will never leave a friend behind.
My honor is my life.
I'll never forget the crushing defeat my company suffered or the enemies who dealt it.
Those who fight beside me are those worth dying for.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.

backgrounds.name: Jedi
backgrounds.flavorText:
You are a devout follower of the Jedi Order: an ancient, monastic peacekeeping organization united in its observance of the light side of the Force. A noble order of protectors noted for their ability to tap into the power of the Force, the Jedi serve as guardians of peace and justice in the Galactic Republic. You follow the Jedi Code:

*"There is no emotion, there is peace.
There is no ignorance, there is knowledge.
There is no passion, there is serenity.
There is no chaos, there is harmony.
There is no death, there is the Force."*
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Investigation, Lore, and Persuasion
backgrounds.equipment: A copy of the Jedi code, a set of common clothes including a robe, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Jedi are shaped by their experience in their temple. Their study of the history and tenets of the Jedi Order and their relationships to temples, shrines, or hierarchies affect their mannerisms and ideals. Their flaws might be some hidden hypocrisy or heretical idea, or an ideal or bond taken to an extreme.
backgrounds.featureText:
As a Jedi, you command the respect of those who are loyal to the Jedi Order. You and your adventuring companions can expect to receive free healing and care at any Jedi temple, and those who support your religion will support you (but only you) at a modest lifestyle.

You might also have ties to a specific Jedi temple and have a residence there. This could be the temple where you trained, or a temple where you have found a new home. While near your temple, you can call upon the Jedi for assistance, provided the assistance you ask for is not hazardous and you remain in good standing with your temple.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I idolize a particular Jedi, and constantly refer to that person's deeds and example.
I can find common ground between the fiercest enemies, empathizing with them and always working towards peace.
I see omens in every event and action. The Force tries to speak to us, we just need to listen
Nothing can shake my optimistic attitude.
I quote (or misquote) sacred Jedi texts and proverbs in almost every situation.
I am tolerant (or intolerant) of those who don't support the Jedi.
I've enjoyed fine food, drink, and high society. Rough living grates on me.
I've spent so long in the Jedi temple that I have little practical experience dealing with people in the  world.

idealOptions.name: Tradition
idealOptions.description: The ancient traditions of worship and sacrifice must be preserved and upheld. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Charity
idealOptions.description: I always try to help those in need, no matter what the personal cost. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Change
idealOptions.description: We must help bring about the changes the Force is constantly working in the world. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Power
idealOptions.description: I hope to one day rise to the rank of Jedi Master. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Faith
idealOptions.description: I trust that the Force will guide my actions; I have faith that if I work hard, things will go well. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I seek to prove myself worthy of the Force by matching my actions against the Jedi teachings. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I judge others harshly, and myself even more severely.
I put too much trust in those who wield power within my temple's hierarchy.
My piety sometimes leads me to blindly trust those that profess faith in the Force.
I am inflexible in my thinking.
I am suspicious of strangers and expect the worst of them.
Once I pick a goal, I become obsessed with it to the detriment of everything else in my life.

bondOptions.description: I would die to recover an ancient Jedi relic that was lost long ago.
I will someday get revenge on those who razed my temple.
I owe my life to the Jedi who took me in when my parents died.
Everything I do is for the common people.
I will do anything to protect the temple where I served.
I seek to preserve a sacred text that my enemies seek to destroy.

backgrounds.name: Mandalorian
backgrounds.flavorText: You are a child of Mandalore. As a member of the most renowned warrior culture in history, your people are known for being strong and hardy. Mandalorian culture is built around the honor and glory that come from victory in battle.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
Mandalorian culture is built on the backbone of various clans. The clan you are a part of has it's own history, allegiances, and fueds which shape your persepctive. Choose an option or roll on the table below to determine your clan.

|d8|Clan|
|:---:|:----------:|
|1|Vizsla|
|2|Fett|
|3|Kryze|
|4|Ordo|

|d8|Clan|
|:---:|:----------:|
|5|Wren|
|6|Lok|
|7|Cadera|
|8|Clanless|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Intimidation, Piloting, and Survival
backgrounds.equipment: A set of traveler's clothes, a trophy from a previous victory, and a pouch containing 200 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Mandalorians are a meritocracy where birthplace, rank, status, and citizenship mean nothing. You are what you do. Mandalorians live by the Resol'nare (the "Six Actions"). As a true Mandalorian you should strive to live by this code as much as possible by remaining honorable. Your flaw(s) might consist of any dishonor you've committed, or even being too honorable.
backgrounds.featureText: Other Mandalorians know, and will look out for you. If you're ever in need of a place to stay, or a meal to eat, other Mandalorians  will help you as long as your clans aren't feuding. This could be in the form of shelters, meals, even healing. If the Mandalorians are of your clan or a clan friendly to you, they may be willing to help you even at cost to themselves.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I try and bring my culture to outsiders.
I always put my clan first.
I follow the Resol'nare to the letter.
I love a good spar.
I enjoy traveling the galaxy.
I keep a small trophy on me to remind me of a past victory.
I view the force as dishonorable in combat.
I've seen the horrors of battle and try to prevent it.

idealOptions.name: Tradition
idealOptions.description: I live by my clan's ways, and will continue to do so. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Power
idealOptions.description: I strive to be the best warrior, no matter who stands in my way. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Respect
idealOptions.description: I have earned the respect of many, and I intend to keep it. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: I enjoy having the ability to do whatever I want. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Comradery
idealOptions.description: I'll put everything on the line for those dear to me. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I'll succeed in my goals, it just takes time and effort. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I look down on outsiders.
I have no respect for anyone who flees. Cowardice is unacceptable.
I don't see much use in talking, a blaster is all I need to make my point.
I stick to my traditions no matter what, even at the cost of others.
I retreated once, and I've regretted it ever since.
I value a victory regardless of the ethics behind the victory.

bondOptions.description: I lost someone dear to me in battle, I will always honor them.
Honor is everything to me.
I will lay down my life for those beside me.
I must keep the traditions of my ancestors alive.
No matter where I go, Mandalore is my home.
In death, I will find glory.

backgrounds.name: Mercenary
backgrounds.flavorText:
As a sell-sword who fought battles for coin, you're well acquainted with risking life and limb for a chance at a share of treasure. Now, you look forward to fighting foes and reaping even greater rewards as an adventurer. Your experience makes you familiar with the ins and outs of mercenary life, and you likely have harrowing stories of events on the battlefield. You might have served with a large outfit or a smaller band of sell-swords, maybe even more than one. 

Now you're looking for something else, perhaps greater reward for the risks you take, or the freedom to choose your own activities. For whatever reason, you're leaving behind the life of a soldier for hire, but your skills are undeniably suited for battle, so now you fight on in a different way.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Investigation, Persuasion, and Piloting
backgrounds.equipment: A uniform of your company (traveler's clothes in quality), an insignia of your rank, a gaming set (one of your choice), and a pouch containing the remainder of your last wages (100 cr)
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Mercenaries are shaped by their lively nature, for the better and the worse. They tend to be driven by either their commitment to money or something more valuable.
backgrounds.featureText: You know the mercenary life as only someone who has experienced it can. You are able to identify mercenary companies by their emblems, and you know a little about any such company, including the names and reputations of its commanders and leaders, and who has hired them recently. You can find the cantinas and feasthalls where mercenaries abide in any area, as long as you speak the language, and if you spend at least an hour in such a location you can come across one of the following bits of information: a job offer, significant rumor, referral to a skilled merchant, blacksmith, etc., or a hint towards the pursuit of your current quest. Additionally, you can find mercenary work between adventures sufficient to maintain a comfortable lifestyle (see "Practicing a Profession" under "Downtime Activities" in chapter 8 of the Player's Handbook).

personalityTraitOptions.description: I do not fear death, but accept it as part of life.
I have a crude sense of humor.
I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success.
I find it good luck to have a flask of ale on me even when the most of my other belongings are gone.
I ask a lot of questions.
I never pass up a friendly wager.
I am always polite and respectful when speaking to those above my station.
I like a job well done, especially if I'm not the one doing it.

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: I'm only doing it for the money. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Fairness
idealOptions.description: We all did the work. it is only right that everyone gets a share of the reward. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: You may not have a family left, but your enemy may. A little compassion goes a long way. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Measure of Last Resort
idealOptions.description: Sometimes we have to do things that we REALLY don't want to do, but we must remember that we only do them because we have to. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Debts
idealOptions.description: I never leave a favor left undone and nor will I leave those whom owe me favors on the hook. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I have heard a tale of a legendary person of my class. I strive to be more like them. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I am always looking for the bigger pay.
I can't tell a lie for the life of me.
I judge too easily by special appearance and pride.
I am almost always carrying some ale in with my gear.
I believe that I am the only skilled person of the group and am even open about it.
I will never let a comrade stand alone, even if it gets me killed.

bondOptions.description: I have a personal debt that must be paid.
I am with friends whom I trust with my life as they should trust me with theirs.
I come from a family that dislikes weaknesses, so I push myself to know my weaknesses.
My life is my honor. I shall, until death, shape my life to what I want it to be.
Without a purpose in the world, I find myself to be broken which I do not like.
I secretly pursue a love interest that is forbidden by a family whether it is my own or my love's family.

backgrounds.name: Noble
backgrounds.flavorText:
You understand wealth, power, and privilege. You carry a noble title, and your family owns land, collects taxes, and wields significant political influence. You might be a pampered aristocrat unfamiliar with manual labor, a former merchant just elevated to the nobility, or an honest, hard-working landowner who cares deeply about the people who live and work on your land.

Work with your GM to come up with an appropriate title and determine how much authority that title carries, as well as your family and their influence on you. Is your family old and established, or was your title only recently bestowed? How much influence do they wield, how do people regard them?

What's your position in the family? Are you the heir to the head of the family or the head itself? Are you far down the line of succession? How does the head of your family feel about your adventuring career? Are you in your family's good graces? 

Does your family have a coat of arms you might wear, a signet ring, or particular colors? 

These details help establish your family and your title as features of the world of the campaign.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Insight, Lore, and Persuasion
backgrounds.equipment: A set of fine clothes, a signet ring, a letter of pedigree, and a purse containing 250 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Nobles are born and raised to a very different lifestyle than most people ever experience, and their personalities reflect that upbringing. A noble title comes with a plethora of bonds�responsibilities to family, to other nobles (including the sovereign), to the people entrusted to the family's care, or even to the title itself. But this responsibility is often a good way to undermine a noble.
backgrounds.featureText: Thanks to your noble birth, people are inclined to think the best of you. You are welcome in high society, and people assume you have the right to be wherever you are. The common folk make every effort to accommodate you and avoid your displeasure, and other people of high birth treat you as a member of the same social sphere. You can secure an audience with a local noble if you need to.

personalityTraitOptions.description: My eloquent flattery makes everyone I talk to feel like the most wonderful and important person in the world.
The common folk love me for my kindness and generosity.
No one could doubt by looking at my regal bearing that I am a cut above the unwashed masses.
I take great pains to always look my best and follow the latest fashions.
I don't like to get my hands dirty, and I won't be caught dead in unsuitable accommodations.
Despite my noble birth, I do not place myself above other folk. We all have the same blood.
My favor, once lost, is lost forever.
If you do me an injury, I will crush you, ruin your name, and salt your fields.

idealOptions.name: Respect
idealOptions.description: Respect is due to me because of my position, but all people regardless of station deserve to be treated with dignity. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Responsibility
idealOptions.description: It is my duty to respect the authority of those above me, just as those below me must respect mine. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Independence
idealOptions.description: I must prove that I can handle myself without the coddling of my family. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Power
idealOptions.description: If I can attain more power, no one will tell me what to do. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Family
idealOptions.description: Blood runs thicker than water. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Noble Obligation
idealOptions.description: It is my duty to protect and care for the people beneath me. (Light)

flawOptions.description: I secretly believe that everyone is beneath me.
I hide a truly scandalous secret that could ruin my family forever.
I too often hear veiled insults and threats in every word addressed to me, and I'm quick to anger.
I have an insatiable desire for carnal pleasures.
In fact, the world does revolve around me.
By my words and actions, I often bring shame to my family.

bondOptions.description: I will face any challenge to win the approval of my family.
My house's alliance with another noble family must be sustained at all costs.
Nothing is more important than the other members of my family.
I am in love with the heir of a family that my family despises.
My loyalty to my sovereign is unwavering.
The common folk must see me as a hero of the people.

backgrounds.name: Nomad
backgrounds.flavorText: You grew up in the wilds, far from civilization and the comforts of town and technology. You've witnessed the migration of herds larger than forests, survived weather more extreme than any city-dweller could comprehend, and enjoyed the solitude of being the only thinking creature for miles in any direction. The wilds are in your blood, whether you were a nomad, an explorer, a recluse, a hunter-gatherer, or even a marauder. Even in places where you don't know the specific features of the terrain, you know the ways of the wild.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Animal Handling, Athletics, Medicine, and Survival
backgrounds.equipment: A walking stick, a hunting trap, a trophy from an animal you killed, a set of traveler's clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Often considered rude and uncouth among civilized folk, nomads have little respect for the niceties of life in the cities. The ties of tribe, clan, family, and the natural world are the most important bonds to nomads.
backgrounds.featureText: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography, and you can always recall the general layout of terrain, settlements, and other features around you. In addition, you can find food and fresh water for yourself and up to five other people each day, provided that the land offers berries, small game, water, and so forth.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I'm driven by a wanderlust that led me away from home.
I watch over my friends as if they were a litter of newborn pups.
I once ran twenty-five miles without stopping to warn my clan of an approaching horde. I'd do it again if I had to.
I have a lesson for every situation, drawn from observing nature.
I place no stock in wealthy or well-mannered folk. Money and manners won't save you from a hungry rancor.
I'm always picking things up, absently fiddling with them, and sometimes accidentally breaking them.
I feel far more comfortable around animals than people.
I was, in fact, raised by wampas.

idealOptions.name: Change
idealOptions.description: Life is like the seasons, in constant change, and we must change with it. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: It is each person's responsibility to make the most happiness for the whole tribe. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Honor
idealOptions.description: If I dishonor myself, I dishonor my whole clan. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: The strongest are meant to rule. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Nature
idealOptions.description: The natural world is more important than all the constructs of civilization. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Glory
idealOptions.description: I must earn glory in battle, for myself and my clan. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I am too enamored of ale, wine, and other intoxicants.
There's no room for caution in a life lived to the fullest.
I remember every insult I've received and nurse a silent resentment toward anyone who's ever wronged me.
I am slow to trust members of other species, tribes, and societies.
Violence is my answer to almost any challenge.
Don't expect me to save those who can't save themselves. It is nature's way that the strong thrive and the weak perish.

bondOptions.description: My family, clan, or tribe is the most important thing in my life, even when they are far from me.
An injury to the unspoiled wilderness of my home is an injury to me.
I will bring terrible wrath down on the Darkdoers who destroyed my homeland.
I am the last of my tribe, and it is up to me to ensure their names enter legend.
I suffer awful visions of a coming disaster and will do anything to prevent it.
It is my duty to provide children to sustain my tribe.

backgrounds.name: Outlaw
backgrounds.flavorText: You are a notorious free adventurer who, due to unfortunate circumstances, has lost favor with the law. However, being of the common people, they protect you due to your just nature. A protector of the people, a thorn in the side of authorities.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
Though you were once just a commoner, a specific event caused you to drastically change your lifestyle and take off for a life of dangerous wandering, or perhaps revenge. Choose or randomly determine a defining event that marked you as an outlaw.

|d10|Defining Event|
|:--:|:--|
|1|I stood up to a tyrant's agents.|
|2|I stole from a corrupt Lord to help the poor.|
|3|I broke into a tyrant's castle and stole weapons to arm the people.|
|4|I failed to assassinate a tyrant.|
|5|I loved a noble, and was caught in bed with them.|
|6|I robbed a bank with unfair interest rates.|
|7|I murdered a pedophilic priest to save local children.|
|8|I received a heroic calling from a mysterious creature.|
|9|I was framed for a crime I didn't commit.|
|10|Outlaw by choice.|

flavorOptions.name: I stood up to a tyrant's agents.
I stole from a corrupt Lord to help the poor.
I broke into a tyrant's castle and stole weapons to arm the people.
I failed to assassinate a tyrant.
I loved a noble, and was caught in bed with them.
I robbed a bank with unfair interest rates.
I murdered a pedophilic priest to save local children.
I received a heroic calling from a mysterious creature.
I was framed for a crime I didn't commit.

backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Acrobatics, Athletics, Insight, and Survival
backgrounds.equipment: A hunting trap, an iron pot, a set of traveler's clothes, and a pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: An outlaw is a hero for the common people who takes pride in his humble origins and revels in disrupting authority to help those he's close to.
backgrounds.featureText: Since you come from the ranks of the common folk, you fit among them with ease. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you've shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I judge people by their actions, not their words.
If someone is in trouble, I'm always ready to lend help.
When I set my mind to something, I follow through no matter what gets in my way.
I have a strong sense of fair play and always try to find the most equitable solution to arguments.
I'm confident in my own abilities and do what I can to instill confidence in others.
Thinking is for other people. I prefer action.
I misuse long words in an attempt to sound smarter.
I get bored easily. When am I going to get on with my destiny?

idealOptions.name: Respect
idealOptions.description: People deserve to be treated with dignity and respect. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Fairness
idealOptions.description: No one should get preferential treatment before the law, and no one is above the law. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Tyrants must not be allowed to oppress the people. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: If I become strong, I can take what I want�what I deserve. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Sincerity
idealOptions.description: There's no good in pretending to be something I'm not. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Destiny
idealOptions.description: Nothing and no one can steer me away from my higher calling. (Any)

flawOptions.description: The tyrant who rules my land will stop at nothing to see me killed.
I'm convinced of the significance of my destiny, and blind to my shortcomings and the risk of failure.
The people who knew me when I was young know my shameful secret, so I can never go home again.
I have a weakness for the vices of the city, especially hard drink.
Secretly, I believe that things would be better if I were a tyrant lording over the land.
I have trouble trusting in my allies.

bondOptions.description: I have a family, but I have no idea where they are. One day, I hope to see them again.
I worked the land, I love the land, and I will protect the land.
A proud noble once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any bully I encounter.
My tools are symbols of my past life, and I carry them so that I will never forget my roots.
I protect those who cannot protect themselves.
I wish my childhood sweetheart had come with me to pursue my destiny.

backgrounds.name: Pirate
backgrounds.flavorText: You are an experienced pirate. Banditry and raiding are common in the Outer Rim, and little negative stigma is given to pirates.  Those that prey on the Empire are sometimes even held in high regard as bold warriors. However, you still have contacts within the criminal underworld and you're far closer than most people to the world of murder, theft, and violence that pervades the underbelly of civilization, and you have survived up to this point by flouting the rules and regulations of finer society.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Deception, Intimidation, and Piloting
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: One type of gaming set, your choice of demolitions kit, security kit, or slicer's kit
backgrounds.equipment: One set of traveler's clothes, a gaming set you are proficient with, poorly wrought maps of Outer Rim worlds in your territory, a small piece of jewelry worth 100 cr from some exotic planet, and a pouch containing 50 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Despite the cutthroat nature of the business, pirates come in all shapes and personalities. Some are bloodthirsty brigands who leave no survivors, others are free spirits who believe in strength over weakness. The hardened warriors of deep space can be implacable foes who often form unshakable bonds with their crewmates. The same circumstances that give them their edge can also grind them down, leaving them vulnerable to greed, shame, and the scars of fear and horror left by battle.
backgrounds.featureText: You've been from one end of the galaxy to the other. You know the most lucrative trade routes. You have expert knowledge of the various hyperlanes. In addition to this, you know a large number of the models and designs of common space ships that are found in the galaxy. Further, the bonds you formed with your crew are strong, and you can call on their aid even if you've been away from their side for some time. You can expect your former comrades to offer you passage aboard ship, reasonable aid, or shelter when you are in need. Keep in mind that this bond goes both ways, and they may come to you expecting the same.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I respect my captain and trust my crew. It may be all that saves my life one day.
Whether the credits comes from the split of the spoils or from a side wager, I'll get my hands on it.
When my blood gets up, my swearing could boil the icy tundra of Hoth.
I enjoy spreading the tales of my exploits, no matter who hears.
I never let witnesses escape from a raid.
I take what I need, but I don't kill without reason.
I always have an exit planned.
I assume everyone else wants to take what I have.

idealOptions.name: Equal Shares
idealOptions.description: All hands who spend sweat and blood earn their share of the credits. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Adventure
idealOptions.description: I'm far from home, and everything is strange and wonderful! (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: I raid to weaken the Empire that threatens my people, but I don't steal from civilians.  (Light)

idealOptions.name: Strength
idealOptions.description: The weak exist to feed the strong, and I am strong. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Crew
idealOptions.description: A ship is nothing without her crew. Protect your mates. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Ambition
idealOptions.description: One day I will be so much more than a captain. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I never back down from a fight.
When faced with a choice between money and my friends, I usually choose the money.
I was drunk on watch when my ship was lost to an ambush. I can't set the shame aside.
I feel I'm entitled to a greater share of the spoils, no matter the circumstances.
I won't let myself be captured. If a raid goes sour, I'm the first to run for cover.
I get lost in the thrill of the raid and can't focus on the details of a plan.

bondOptions.description: My band and I will be known across the world, and we'll never be forgotten.
My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.
Everything I do is for the good of my people.
My ship and many of her crew were lost to treachery, and I won't rest until I discover who was behind it.
My ship comes first, and all other loyalties simply pale in comparison.
A crew member of a ship we raided saved my life, and I don't know how to resolve that debt.

backgrounds.name: Scientist
backgrounds.flavorText:
Nothing excites you more than pushing the boundaries of scientific knowledge. Most of your time is spent in a lab performing experiments to further your interests. Few people understand the work you do. You can solve complex problems most people can't begin to wrap their heads around, and can solve simple problems in unexpected ways that surprise most people. 

What is your scientific field of interest? Is it your insatiable curiousity, or a personal goal that drives you? Did you leave your lab voluntarily, or were you kicked out? One thing is for sure - there are too many interesting research ideas, and too little time.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
While scientist's are widely knowledgeable, they also choose a focus for their studies. Choose an option or roll on the table below to define your field of research.

| d8 | Field of Research  |
|:----:|:-------------|
| 1  | Biology |
| 2  | Artificial Intelligence |
| 3 | Chemistry |
| 4 | Geology |

| d8 | Field of Research  |
|:----:|:-------------|
| 5 | Physics |
| 6 | the Force |
| 7 | Astrogation |
| 8 | Medicine |
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Lore, Medicine, Nature, and Technology
backgrounds.equipment: A set of common clothes, a datapad, a book on your field of research, a pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Scientist are interested in things most don't care about. Their research is their life, and drives their personality traits. Their flaws, ideals, and bond are a result of their hours spent researching.
backgrounds.featureText: You are well acquainted with your field of research from having read numerous journals or having attended scientific conferences. Concepts that are complicated, involving technical jargon that usually goes over most people's heads, are simple to you. You fully understand concepts, can recall key information, and know how to use equipment related to your field, unless the research was hidden from the public, in which case you may only partially understand it. You also recognize well-known figures in your field.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I look up to a renowned scientist in my field, and often talk about their work.
I constantly compare my current situation to my past experiments, many of which went terrifyingly wrong.
I believe scientific results always comes first.
I only speak in short incomplete and concise sentences, as they are optimized for efficient communication.
I often get lost in my own thoughts and contemplation, becoming oblivious to my surroundings.
I am unable to think logically under great stress, and begin to shout random scientific words.
I do not believe in etiquette and disregard social expectations.
I was, in fact, grown and raised in a laboratory.

idealOptions.name: Transparency
idealOptions.description: All discoveries should be open to everyone. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Logic
idealOptions.description: Emotions must not cloud our sense of what is right and true, or our logical thinking. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: I'm only in it for the money and fame. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Free Thinking
idealOptions.description: Inquiry and curiosity are the pillars of progress. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: Meddling in the affairs of others only causes trouble. (Balanced)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I work hard to be the best there is at my craft. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I believe only other scientists deserve my respect.
I fail to understand why people don't understand my technical jargon.
I experiment on myself without thinking about the long term consequences.
I am paranoid that people are out to steal my research.
I believe I work better when under the influence of intoxicants.
I work on my research to the point where I ignore my own bodily needs.

bondOptions.description: My research is also my best companion.
I will get revenge on the criminals that stole my research.
The school I studied at is the most important place in the world to me.
One day I will return to my home planet and prove that I am the greatest scientist of them all.
I believe my research will be the key to saving the life of a loved one.
I owe my instructor a great debt for forging me into the person I am today.

backgrounds.name: Scoundrel
backgrounds.flavorText: You have always had a way with people. You can tease out their heart's desires after a few minutes of conversation, and with a few leading questions you can read them like they were children's books. It's a useful talent, and one that you're perfectly willing to use for your advantage. You know what people want and you promise to deliver, coaxing people into otherwise foolish decisions. You make the improbable sound plausible, and come ahead on every deal.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
Every scoundrel has an angle they use in preference to other schemes. Choose a favorite scam or roll on the table below.

|d6|Scam|
|:--:|:--:|
|1|I cheat at games involving chance.|
|2|I shave creds or forge documents.|
|3|I insinuate myself into people's lives to prey on their weakness and secure their fortunes.|
|4|I put on new identities like clothes.|
|5|I run sleight-of-hand cons on street corners.|
|6|I convince people that worthless junk is worth their hard-earned money.|

flavorOptions.name: I cheat at games involving chance.
I shave creds or forge documents.
I insinuate myself into people's lives to prey on their weakness and secure their fortunes.
I put on new identities like clothes.
I run sleight-of-hand cons on street corners.
I convince people that worthless junk is worth their hard-earned money.

backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Insight, Performance, and Sleight of Hand
backgrounds.equipment: A set of fine clothes, a disguise kit, a memento of a former con, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Scoundrels are colorful characters who conceal their true selves behind the masks they construct. They reflect what people want to see, what they want to believe, and how they see the world. But their true selves are sometimes plagued by an uneasy conscience, an old enemy, or deep-seated trust issues.
backgrounds.featureText:
You have created a second identity that includes documentation, established acquaintances, and disguises that allow you to assume that persona.

Additionally, you can forge documents including official papers and personal letters, as long as you have seen an example of the kind of document or the handwriting you are trying to copy.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I fall in and out of love easily, and am always pursuing someone.
I have a joke for every occasion, especially occasions where humor is inappropriate.
Flattery is my preferred trick for getting what I want.
I'm a born gambler who can't resist taking a risk for a potential payoff.
I lie about almost everything, even when there's no good reason to.
Sarcasm and insults are my weapons of choice.
I keep multiple symbols on me and invoke whatever power might come in useful at any given moment.
I pocket anything I see that might have some value.

idealOptions.name: Independence
idealOptions.description: I am a free spirit� no one tells me what to do. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Fairness
idealOptions.description: I never target people who can't afford to lose a few creds. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Charity
idealOptions.description: I distribute the money I acquire to the people who really need it. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Creativity
idealOptions.description: I never run the same con twice. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Friendship
idealOptions.description: Material goods come and go. Bonds of friendship last forever. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I'm determined to make something of myself. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I can't resist a pretty face.
I'm always in debt. I spend my ill-gotten gains on decadent luxuries faster than I bring them in.
I'm convinced that no one could ever fool me the way I fool others.
I'm too greedy for my own good. I can't resist taking a risk if there's money involved.
I can't resist swindling people who are more powerful than me.
I hate to admit it and will hate myself for it, but I'll run and preserve my own hide if the going gets tough.

bondOptions.description: I fleeced the wrong person and must work to ensure that this individual never crosses paths with me or those I care about.
I owe everything to my mentor�a horrible person who's probably rotting in jail somewhere.
Somewhere out there, I have a child who doesn't know me. I'm making the world better for him or her.
I come from a noble family, and one day I'll reclaim my lands and title from those who stole them from me.
A powerful person killed someone I love. Some day soon, I'll have my revenge.
I swindled and ruined a person who didn't deserve it, and I seek to atone for my misdeeds.

backgrounds.name: Sith
backgrounds.flavorText:
You are an acolyte of the Sith Order: an ancient order of Force-wielders devoted to the dark side of the Force. Emerging as a divergent faction to the Jedi Order, the Sith are mortal enemies of the Jedi and fight against them. Driven by emotions such as hate, anger, and greed, the Sith are deceptive and ultimately obsessed with amassing power no matter the cost. You follow the Sith Code:

*"Peace is a lie. There is only passion.
Through passion I gain strength.
Through strength I gain power.
Through power I gain victory.
Through victory my chains are broken.
The Force shall free me."*
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Insight, Intimidation, and Lore
backgrounds.equipment: A copy of the Sith code, a set of common clothes including a robe, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Sith are shaped by their training. They study the Sith code and use it to oppress the weak and quell resistance. Their study of the Sith code affects their mannerisms and ideals. Their flaws might be some hidden hypocrisy or heretical idea, or an ideal or bond taken to an extreme.
backgrounds.featureText: As a Sith, you instill fear in those who are aware of your standing. When you are in a civilized environment, you can get away with minor criminal offenses, such as refusing to pay for food at a cantina or cutting through doors at a local shop, since most people will not report your activity to the authorities.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I idolize a particular Sith, and constantly refer to that person's deeds and example.
I seek power above all else.
I prefer using a lightsaber to solve my problems.
I have a plan for any situation.
I believe everyone is beneath me.
I prefer to let someone else do my dirty work.
Hatred and anger drive every decision I make.
Lying and scheming are second nature to me.

idealOptions.name: Patience
idealOptions.description: I will defeat my enemies in the end, I'm in no rush. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Disdain
idealOptions.description: I never try to help those in need, regardless of how simple it would be. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Knowledge
idealOptions.description: The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Power
idealOptions.description: I hope to one day rise to the rank of Dark Lord of the Sith. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: If I become strong, I can take what I want�what I deserve. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I'll succeed in my goals at any cost. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I am too merciful, and empathize with those I shouldn't.
I put too much trust in those who rule over me.
I will never fully trust anyone other than myself.
I am inflexible in my thinking.
My pride will probably lead to my destruction.
Failure frightens me, and I get desperate if I think I might fail.

bondOptions.description: I would die to recover an ancient Sith relic that was lost long ago.
I care only about myself.
I owe my life to the Sith who took me in when my parents died.
My enemies will be defeated, even if it costs me my life.
Someone I love was killed. Some day soon, I'll have my revenge.
My loyalty to my master is unwavering.

backgrounds.name: Smuggler
backgrounds.flavorText: You have spent your life hiding in the darkness, making shady deals behind closed doors. What led you to engage in a life of crime? Do you crave the thrill of lawbreaking, or did you enter the profession to pay off a debt, risking your hide on behalf of a less than honorable noble? A smuggler is an individual trained in the art of acquisition, a professional thug who can deliver anything... for a price. Smugglers tend to be bolder criminals than most, preferring bribery or distraction over subterfuge and stealth.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Piloting, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: One type of gaming set and your choice of demolitions kit, security kit, or slicer's kit
backgrounds.equipment: A fusion cutter, a set of dark common clothes including a hood, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Smugglers might seem like villains on the surface, and many of them are nefarious to the core. But some have an abundance of endearing, if not redeeming, characteristics. There might be honor among thieves, but spies rarely show any respect for law or authority.
backgrounds.featureText: Some close brushes with the law have taught you that not every city guard can be bribed, and some people are simply too keen to miss minute discrepancies. This feature allows you to study a person and gain insight into whether or not they would accept a bribe, or to pick up on whether they are exceptionally more perceptive than you. It does not reveal how expensive a bribe may be for a given situation, however.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I am extremely sociable, especially over a mug of ale.
I always keep my wares close to me, you never know who might stumble across them otherwise.
The best way to hide is out in the open.
I'm a terrible gossip.
Being seen with any unsavory figures is a sure way to undermine my work, which is why I work out of sight.
Deflecting questions has become second nature to me, so I rarely answer straight.
I have dozens of identities and live in constant fear of answering to the wrong name.
I act irrationally confident in the face of danger, nobody suspects anything when you seem like you're in charge.

idealOptions.name: Morals
idealOptions.description: I only smuggle things to improve the lives of the common folk. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Ruthless
idealOptions.description: I will rise to the top of the heap by any means necessary. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Friendship
idealOptions.description: My associates are dear to me, and I want them to rise with me when I hit it big. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Dauntless
idealOptions.description: No border crossing or bribe is too difficult- that's just the coward's way of saying exciting! (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: I work for a greater cause, and ply my trade only in service to it. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Unperturbed
idealOptions.description: I only want to make a living for myself, and smuggling is just an edge I can use to do so. (Neutral)

flawOptions.description: "Trust nobody, not even yourself." I am plagued by paranoia.
I'm so charismatic that sometimes I woo myself. Who am I, Narcissus?
Money is my greatest motivator. I'll do almost anything given enough of it, even if I'll regret it later.
I would betray anyone to save my own skin.
I detach myself from the results of my actions in order to sleep better at night.
Someone who knows me well might call me "two-faced" but those who don't have no idea what hit 'em.

bondOptions.description: A corrupt official shut me down back in my honest days. I aim to show him a thing or two about recovery.
I never wanted to be a criminal, but it pays the bills.
A bloodthirsty pirate stole a shipment from me and killed a dear friend of mine. I will have my vengeance.
Someone I cared about discovered my profession and has publicly denounced me, and I am caught between protecting my reputation and restoring our relationship.
My love interest is someone who once stole from right under my nose- but they have no idea who I am or how much I admire them for their accomplishment.
My business partners are closer to me than my family.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.flavorText:
War has been your life for as long as you care to remember. You trained as a youth, studied the use of weapons and armor, learned basic survival techniques, including how to stay alive on the battlefield. You might have been part of a standing national army, a mercenary company, or perhaps a member of a local militia who rose to prominence during a recent war.

When you choose this background, work with your GM to determine which military organization you were a part of, how far through its ranks you progressed, and what kind of experiences you had during your military career. Was it a standing army, a town guard, a village militia, or perhaps a private company.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
During your time as a soldier, you had a specific role to play in your unit or army. Roll a d8 or choose from the options in the table below to determine your role:

|d8|Specialty|
|:---:|:----------:|
|1|Officer|
|2|Scout|
|3|Infantry|
|4|Medic|

|d8|Specialty|
|:---:|:----------:|
|5|Quartermaster|
|6|Pilot|
|7|Artisan|
|8|Support Staff|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Intimidation, Persuasion, and Piloting
backgrounds.equipment: An insignia of rank, a trophy taken from a fallen enemy, a gaming set (one of your choice), a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: The horrors of war combined with the rigid discipline of military service leave their mark on all soldiers, shaping their ideals, creating strong bonds, and often leaving them scarred and mentally vulnerable.
backgrounds.featureText: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier. Soldiers loyal to your former military organization still recognize your authority and influence, and they defer to you if they are of a lower rank. You can invoke your rank to exert influence over other soldiers and requisition simple equipment for temporary use. You can also usually gain access to friendly military encampments where your rank is recognized.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I'm always polite and respectful.
I'm haunted by memories of war. I can't get the images of violence out of my mind.
I've lost too many friends, and I'm slow to make new ones.
I'm full of inspiring and cautionary tales from my military experience relevant to almost every combat situation.
I can stare down a hell hound without flinching.
I enjoy being strong and like breaking things.
I have a crude sense of humor.
I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success.

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: Our lot is to lay down our lives in defense of others. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Responsibility
idealOptions.description: I do what I must and obey just authority. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Independence
idealOptions.description: When people follow orders blindly, they embrace a kind of tyranny. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: In life as in war, the stronger force wins. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: Ideals aren't worth killing over or going to war for. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Nation
idealOptions.description: My city, nation, or people are all that matter. (Any)

flawOptions.description: The monstrous enemy we faced in battle still leaves me quivering with fear.
I have little respect for anyone who is not a proven warrior.
I made a terrible mistake in battle cost many lives� and I would do anything to keep that mistake secret.
My hatred of my enemies is blind and unreasoning.
I obey the law, even if the law causes misery.
I'd rather eat my armor than admit when I'm wrong.

bondOptions.description: I would still lay down my life for the people I served with.
Someone saved my life on the battlefield. To this day, I will never leave a friend behind.
My honor is my life.
I'll never forget the crushing defeat my company suffered or the enemies who dealt it.
Those who fight beside me are those worth dying for.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.

backgrounds.name: Spacer
backgrounds.flavorText: Aboard a star ship in the cold vacuum of space is where you feel most at home. You've spent the majority of your life travelling the stars. Life aboard ships has given you a good understanding of their inner workings. You might be especially skilled as a ship mechanic, a pilot, or support staff.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
During your time as a spacer, you had a specific role to play aboard the ship. Roll a d8 or choose from the options in the table below to determine your role:
|d8|Specialty| |:---:|:----------:| |1|Pilot| |2|Mechanic| |3|Support Staff| |4|Guard| |d8|Specialty| |:---:|:----------:| |5|Ship Medic| |6|Captain| |7|Communications Officer| |8|Ship Cook|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Investigation, Piloting, and Technology
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: Your choice of chef's kit, mechanic's kit, or one type of gaming set
backgrounds.equipment: A set of tools or a gaming set (one of your choice), a set of common clothes, a small souvenir from your travels, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Spacers come from all walks of life, and the responsibilities of life aboard a ship make them generally reliable as well. Spending so much time on their ship shapes their outlook and forms their most important attachments.
backgrounds.featureText: As a spacer, you've been from one end of the galaxy to the other. You've traveled along many of the trade routes, and know the safest routes. You have expert knowledge of the various hyperlanes. In addition to this, you know a large number of the models and designs of common space ships that are found in the galaxy.

personalityTraitOptions.description: My crewmates know they can rely on me, no matter what.
I work hard so that I can play hard when the work is done.
I enjoy traveling into new systems and making new friends over a drink.
I stretch the truth for the sake of a good story.
To me, a bar brawl is a nice way to get to know a new city.
I never pass up a friendly wager.
The best way to get me to do something is to tell me I can't do it.
I like a job well done, especially if I can convince someone else to do it.

idealOptions.name: Respect
idealOptions.description: The thing that keeps a ship together is mutual respect between captain and crew. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Fairness
idealOptions.description: We all do the work, so we all share in the rewards. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Space is freedom � the freedom to go anywhere and do anything. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Mastery
idealOptions.description: I'm a predator, and the other ships we come across are my prey. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: People
idealOptions.description: I'm committed to my crewmates, not to ideals. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: Someday, I'll own my own ship and chart my own destiny. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I follow orders, even if I think they're wrong.
I'll say anything to avoid having to do extra work.
Once someone questions my courage, I never back down no matter how dangerous the situation.
Once I start drinking, it's hard for me to stop.
I can't help but pocket loose coins and other trinkets I come across.
My pride will probably lead to my destruction.

bondOptions.description: I'm loyal to my captain first, everything else second.
The ship is most important�crewmates and captains come and go.
I'll always remember my first ship.
I will become the greatest captain that ever lived.
I was cheated out of my fair share of the profits, and I want to get my due.
Ruthless space pirates murdered my captain and crewmates, stole all we owned, and left me to die. Vengeance will be mine.

backgrounds.name: (Un)Retired Adventurer
backgrounds.flavorText:
"I'm getting too old for this stuff."

You spent your life as an adventurer, learning the use of many skills and basic survival techniques, including how to stay alive in a hostile area. You might have been part of a famous adventuring party or a less renowned one.

When you choose this background, work with your GM to determine the details of your previous adventuring party, and what kind of experiences you had in your adventuring career. How famous was your previous adventuring party and how well known are you? What did you learn? What was your group's specialty?
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Insight, Lore, and Survival
backgrounds.equipment: A grappling hook, one tool with which you are proficient, a memento of an unsuccessful expedition (map to a never found treasure, lock of hair from a fallen companion, or another trinket),  and a pouch containing your last 50 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: The trials and triumphs of retired adventurers have left an impact, shaping their ideals, creating strong bonds, and often leaving them scarred and vulnerable to fear, shame, and hatred.
backgrounds.featureText: Throughout your adventures you have established a multitude of contacts from all walks of life, but the intervening years have seen those relationships strained. You may use any feature of any other background, but once a particular feature is used, that feature can't be used again until one year has passed.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I'm always polite and respectful.
I'm haunted by memories of war. I can't get the images of violence out of my mind.
I've lost too many friends, and I'm slow to make new ones.
I'm full of inspiring and cautionary tales from my adventuring experience relevant to almost every combat situation.
I can stare down a rancor without flinching.
I enjoy being strong and like breaking things.
I have a crude sense of humor.
I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success.

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: Our lot is to lay down our lives in defense of others. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Responsibility
idealOptions.description: I do what I must and obey just authority. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Independence
idealOptions.description: When people follow orders blindly, they embrace a kind of tyranny. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: In life as in war, the stronger force wins. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: Ideals aren't worth killing over or going to war for. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Nation
idealOptions.description: My city, nation, or people are all that matter. (Any)

flawOptions.description: The monstrous enemy we faced in battle still leaves me quivering with fear.
I have little respect for anyone who is not a proven adventurer.
I made a terrible mistake in battle cost many lives� and I would do anything to keep that mistake secret.
My hatred of my enemies is blind and unreasoning.
I obey the law, even if the law causes misery.
I'd rather eat my armor than admit when I'm wrong.

bondOptions.description: I would still lay down my life for the people I adventured with.
Someone saved my life when they could have left me. To this day, I will never leave a friend behind.
My honor is my life.
I'll never forget the crushing defeat my party suffered or the enemies who dealt it.
Those who fight beside me are those worth dying for.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.

backgrounds.name: Addict
backgrounds.flavorText: You hammer down your fifth bottle of the night, do your last bit of snuff, and bid farewell to the seedy cantina barman. You stagger onto the streets and find a nearby alley in which you empty the night's contents. To many, the next morning's hangovers would be hell. To you, they're a ritual.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
While most addicts are willing to try everything once, they typically have a drug of choice. You can determine what the source of your addiction or determine it randomly below.

|d16|Substance of Choice|
|:---:|:----------:|
|1|Deuterium-pyro|	
|2|Mummergy|
|3|Novanian grog|	
|4|Raava|
|5|Spicebrew|
|6|Tihaar|
|7|Tsiraki|
|8|Vayerbok|

|d16|Substance of Choice|
|:---:|:----------:|
|9|Andris|
|10|Cilona|
|11|Giggledust|
|12|Glitterstim|
|13|Karrak|
|14|Muon gold|	
|15|Yaladai|
|16|Yarrock|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Performance, Persuasion, and Sleight of Hand
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: Your choice of any gaming set, brewer's kit, or spicer's kit
backgrounds.equipment: A chance cube set, a sabaac deck, 2 days field rations, a flask or belt pouch containing your addiction, a set of common clothes, a bedroll, and a belt pouch containing 25 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Addicts can be rude and uncouth, wearing their addiction visibly, or they might hide that addiction and appear to function normally. Importantly, and varying with every addict, why are you addicted? To forget the past? To drown your sorrows? Or are you simply chasing the dragon?
backgrounds.featureText: You've been abusing substances for a long time. You always know who to talk to and where to find substances, and you can often identify them in their raw form.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I am guaranteed to fight someone if I'm drunk/high enough.
Life is pain. All I want is to drink/smoke myself into nothingness.
I have a simple rule; life's a party, so grab the deathsticks!
The only thing keeping me from burning down this village is the fact that you make some damn good spice.
I'm quite reserved until the moment I fulfill my addictive needs.
This stuff is a bit weak, do you have anything higher than 60% in the back?
I take pride in my addiction and am often snobbish when talking about it.
I blow up at the slightest insult.

idealOptions.name: Hope
idealOptions.description: I hope to one day be free of my addiction. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Carelessness
idealOptions.description: I don't care what I have to do, just let me feed my addiction. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Isolation
idealOptions.description: Just let me deal with my demons in peace. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Caution
idealOptions.description: I will never let my addiction harm others. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Independence
idealOptions.description: Addiction frees me. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Comradery
idealOptions.description: Hey, some of my favorite people are addicts! (Any)

flawOptions.description: This could be rough, let's take something before we go.
Hopefully this will be the one to end it.
The mission can wait, we should find some dealers first.
What? I don't have a problem. You're the one with the problem!
It looks like my drug, so it should be safe to take right?
I'm never myself when I'm on it.

bondOptions.description: I use my addiction as a tool to wash away my past sins.
My family never wanted to be forgotten. I take drugs in the hopes they will be.
I hope to start a drug business myself and give people the same happiness I've found.
Everything I do is in the hopes of getting my hands on my drug.
I traded my former self to my addiction. Now I need to find a way to get him back.
To be addicted is to be truly alive.

backgrounds.name: Amnesiac
backgrounds.flavorText: One day you awoke, perhaps in a forest or on a sandy beach, with no recollection of what happened to you. How did you get here? Who were you? These questions elude and boggle your mind. Some people wish for a fresh start, but you never even got a choice.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Insight, Investigation, and Survival
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: Choose one from disguise kit, forgery kit, or tinker's implements
backgrounds.equipment: A set of common clothes, a relic of your past which you do not remember, and a belt pouch containing 200 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: The important things to consider when choosing this background are how your character has dealt with starting life anew and what have they done to set down that path.
backgrounds.featureText: You once had a home, a family, relationships, possessions, but now you are left with nothing but the ability to start anew. You are unfamiliar with the world around you as well as the people in it. You may often need to ask for clarification on things other adventurers may know intrinsically. Some events, locations, names, phrases, or objects may also trigger you to recall small details which could relate to the life you once had, at the discretion of the GM.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I don't know who you are but I'll try to help you.
I will let nothing stop my quest for answers.
Even if I never find out who I was before, I will know who I am now.
I am sometimes clumsy when speaking. I must've not been very eloquent.
I shy away from forging new relationships. I don't want to leave anyone behind again.
Having no memories of the past has left me feeling free and happy.
I am eager to learn and devour any knowledge I can.
I am insightful and can often see things from other peoples point of view.

idealOptions.name: Conscience
idealOptions.description: I've forgotten before, I can forget again.  I don't let my conscience get in the way of my actions. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: With no past to tie me down I do was I will. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Respect
idealOptions.description: People deserve to be treated with respect. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Past
idealOptions.description: I will destroy whatever I have to in order to reclaim what I once had. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: Ideals aren't worth killing over or going to war for. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Memory
idealOptions.description: Finding out my history drives every action I do. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I've lost all hope since I woke up.
I'm obsessed with the life I left behind.
Sometimes I crack under the stress of starting new.
I get tunnel vision when investigating my past life.
I no longer care about anything. It could all be gone in an instant.
I am constantly angry about forgetting everything.

bondOptions.description: I will never rest until I find out what happened to me.
I have a family out there who's looking for me. I can't let them down.
I was given a chance to start fresh, and I'm not taking it for granted.
My entire life was lost in the blink of an eye. What's the point of all this?
I've already lost everything. Now I do as I please.
I will become something great so that even if I forget, others won't.

backgrounds.name: Archaeologist
backgrounds.flavorText: An archaeologist learns about the long-lost and fallen cultures of the past by studying their remains � their bones, their ruins, their surviving masterworks, and their tombs. Those who practice archaeology travel to the far corners of the world to root through crumbled cities and lost dungeons, digging in search of artifacts that might tell the stories of monarchs and high priests, wars and cataclysms.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
Prior to becoming an adventurer, you spent most of your young life crawling around in the dust, pilfering relics of questionable value from crypts and ruins. Though you managed to sell a few of your discoveries and earn enough credits to buy proper adventuring gear, you have held onto an item that has great emotional value to you. You can determine your signature item or determine it randomly below.

|d8|Signature Item|
|:---:|:----------:|
|1|10-foot pole|	
|2|Hat|
|3|Hammer|	
|4|Lantern|

|d8|Signature Item|
|:---:|:----------:|
|5|Medallion|
|6|Prybar|
|7|Shovel|
|8|Whip|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Investigation, Lore, Perception, or Survival
backgrounds.equipment: A case containing a physical or digital map to a ruin or dungeon, a lantern, a vibropick, a set of traveler's clothes, a shovel, a two-person tent, a trinket recovered from a dig site, and a pouch containing 250 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Few archaeologists can resist the lure of an unexplored ruin or dungeon, particularly if such a site is the source of legends or is rumored to contain noteworthy relics. Whatever their motivations, they combine the likes of a dutiful historian with those of a dogged scoundrel.
backgrounds.featureText: When you enter a ruin or dungeon, you can correctly ascertain its original purpose and determine its builders, whether those were jedi, sith, hutts, rakata, or some other known species or civilization. Additionally, you can readily determine the value of ancient art.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I love a good puzzle or mystery.
I'm a pack rat who never throws anything away.
Fame is more important to me than money.
I have no qualms about stealing from the dead.
I'm happier in a dusty old tomb than I am in the centers of civilization.
Traps don't make me nervous. Idiots who trigger traps make me nervous.
I might fail, but I will never give up.
You might think I'm a scholar, but I love a good brawl. These fists were made for punching.

idealOptions.name: Preservation
idealOptions.description: That artifact belongs in a museum. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: I won't risk my life for nothing. I expect some kind of payment. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Death Wish
idealOptions.description: Nothing is more exhilarating than a narrow escape from the jaws of death. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Dignity
idealOptions.description: The dead and their belongings deserve to be treated with respect. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Immortality
idealOptions.description: All my exploring is part of a plan to find the secret of everlasting life. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Danger
idealOptions.description: With every great discovery comes grave danger. The two walk hand in hand. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I have a secret fear of some common wild animal, and in my work, I see them everywhere.
I can't leave a room without searching it for secret doors.
When I'm not exploring dungeons or ruins, I get jittery and impatient.
I have no time for friends or family. I spend every waking moment thinking about and preparing for my next expedition.
When given the choice of going left or right, I always go left.
I can't sleep except in total darkness.

bondOptions.description: Ever since I was a child, I've heard stories about a lost city. I aim to find it, learn its secrets, and earn my place in the history books.
I want to find my mentor, who disappeared on an expedition some time ago.
I have a friendly rival. Only one of us can be the best, and I aim to prove it's me.
I won't sell an art object or other treasure that has historical significance or is one of a kind.
I'm secretly in love with the wealthy patron who sponsors my archaeological exploits.
I hope to bring prestige to an library, a museum, or a university.

backgrounds.name: Barbarian
backgrounds.flavorText:
Though you might have only recently arrived in civilized lands, you are no stranger to the values of cooperation and group effort when striving for supremacy. You learned these principles, and much more, as a member of your tribe.

Your people have always tried to hold to the old ways. Tradition and taboo have kept your tribe strong while the kingdoms of others have collapsed into chaos and ruin. But for the last few generations, some bands among the tribes were tempted to settle, make peace, trade, and even to build towns. Perhaps this is why your tribe chose to raise up the totems among the people as living embodiments of his power. Perhaps they needed a reminder of who they were and from whence they came. The Chosen of your tribe led bands back to the old ways, and most of your people abandoned the soft ways of civilization.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Animal Handling, Athletics, Nature, and Survival
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: One type of musical instrument or artisan's implements
backgrounds.equipment: A hunting trap, a totemic token or set of tattoos marking your loyalty to your tribe, a set of traveler's clothes, and a pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Often considered rude and uncouth among civilized folk, barbarians have little respect for the niceties of life in the cities. The ties of tribe, clan, family, and the natural world of which they are a part are the most important bonds to most outlanders.
backgrounds.featureText:
You have an excellent knowledge of not only your tribe's territory, but also the terrain and natural resources of the rest of the worlds. You are familiar enough with any wilderness area that you find twice as much food and water as you normally would when you forage there.

Additionally, you can call upon the hospitality of other tribes in times of need.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I'm driven by a wanderlust that led me away from home.
I watch over my friends as if they were a litter of newborn pups.
