I once ran twenty-five miles without stopping to warn my clan of an approaching horde. I'd do it again if I had to.
I have a lesson for every situation, drawn from observing nature.
I place no stock in wealthy or well-mannered folk. Money and manners won't save you from a hungry rancor.
I'm always picking things up, absently fiddling with them, and sometimes accidentally breaking them.
I feel far more comfortable around animals than people.
I was, in fact, raised by wampas.

idealOptions.name: Change
idealOptions.description: Life is like the seasons, in constant change, and we must change with it. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: It is each person's responsibility to make the most happiness for the whole tribe. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Honor
idealOptions.description: If I dishonor myself, I dishonor my whole clan. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: The strongest are meant to rule. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Nature
idealOptions.description: The natural world is more important than all the constructs of civilization. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Glory
idealOptions.description: I must earn glory in battle, for myself and my clan. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I am too enamored of ale, wine, and other intoxicants.
There's no room for caution in a life lived to the fullest.
I remember every insult I've received and nurse a silent resentment toward anyone who's ever wronged me.
I am slow to trust members of other species, tribes, and societies.
Violence is my answer to almost any challenge.
Don't expect me to save those who can't save themselves. It is nature's way that the strong thrive and the weak perish.

bondOptions.description: My family, clan, or tribe is the most important thing in my life, even when they are far from me.
An injury to the unspoiled wilderness of my home is an injury to me.
I will bring terrible wrath down on the Darkdoers who destroyed my homeland.
I am the last of my tribe, and it is up to me to ensure their names enter legend.
I suffer awful visions of a coming disaster and will do anything to prevent it.
It is my duty to provide children to sustain my tribe.

backgrounds.name: Bartender
backgrounds.flavorText: Sometimes you want to go where everybody knows your name and they're always glad you came. As a bartender, you're a charismatic fellow that knows how to deal with people. Whether you're the life of the party or simply an ear for someone who needs advice, people from all walks of life are drawn to your trustworthy nature.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, or Persuasion
backgrounds.equipment: A set of common clothes, a brewer's kit, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: A bartender's demeanor ranges from jovial to downright rude. Regardless, all bartenders know how to take care of business�they break up fights, kick out drunk patrons, and offer honest counsel to people down on their luck.
backgrounds.featureText: You have no trouble finding and getting into places that serve drinks. While drinking in a social establishment, strangers take a liking to you and feel comfortable enough to share gossip.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I'm always looking for a good time with good company.
I earnestly enjoy offering advice.
Even in a social atmosphere, I always feel alone.
I live vicariously through the people I meet and the stories I hear.
I'm everyone's outlet but sometimes I just want to punch them in their thoughtless face.
If you're looking for a fight, I'll give you one.
TI know how to calm people down, but I also know how to rile them up.
It's not all fun and games. Business needs to run smoothly, whatever that might be.

idealOptions.name: Cheer
idealOptions.description: Spreading joy is my passion. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Guidance
idealOptions.description: It's our duty to help others. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Legacy
idealOptions.description: We have only one chance to write our story. Do what you will and make it count. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Manipulation
idealOptions.description: Drunk people are the most vulnerable and can easily be taken advantage of. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: People
idealOptions.description: It's always good to meet and connect with new people. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Honesty
idealOptions.description: If I call you a nerf herder, it means I like you. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I can always go for another round. The gutter is my second home.
I judge people that don't drink to be antisocial and untrustworthy.
Party animals and depressed people make me feel bitter about my life.
Whenever life gets hard, I drink my problems away.
I need to know everyone's story.
I curse more than a kriffing sailor.

bondOptions.description: My cantina means everything to me. It brings back important memories from my past.
Brewing is my craft. My art brings people together.
The regular patrons of my cantina are like family to me.
I want to be successful. Whatever it takes.
Alcohol is all I ened, and sometimes all I want.
I've met so many people while staying in the same place. I need my own story to tell.

backgrounds.name: Blackguard
backgrounds.flavorText: You are a member of the Blackguard: a reclusive sect of Force users from the planet of Mustafar. Rather than being determined by the Force, the Blackguard believe that the light or dark dwell within the user, and that to truly increase one's knowledge and strength in the Force, one must understand and seek out the philosophies and abilities of other Force traditions around the galaxy.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Investigation, Lore, and Survival
backgrounds.equipment: A copy of a Force-wielder organization's text, a trinket from your travels around the galaxy, a set of common clothes including a robe, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: The Blackguard are galactic travelers and students, looking to expand their horizons and knowledge of the Force by learning from others.
backgrounds.featureText: You often know where to find information on Force-sensitive organizations, or where to find someone who would know, and can readily decipher more common lore about them. Your GM might rule that the knowledge you seek is secreted away in an almost inaccessible place, that it simply cannot be found, or is too difficult to decipher.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I let my actions speak for themselves.
I've left emotion behind me, I'm now perfectly placid.
I question every Force user I meet, trying to acquire every piece of knowledge I can.
I'm willing to listen to every side of an argument before I make my own judgment.
I spend every free moment training in lightsaber techniques.
I judge people by their actions, not their words.
When I set my mind to something, I follow through no matter what gets in my way.
I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success.

idealOptions.name: Knowledge
idealOptions.description: The path to true understanding of the Force is through knowledge. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: Knowledge is the path to power and domination. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Defense
idealOptions.description: The Blackguard protect that which others would seek to destroy. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Loyalty
idealOptions.description: The Blackguard Order watches its own. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Balance
idealOptions.description: There is no light or dark. There is only the Force. (Balanced)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: True freedom rejects the restrictions of the Jedi and Sith. (Chaos)

flawOptions.description: I believe that everyone is beneath me.
I am easily distracted by the promise of information.
I have little respect for anyone who is not a proven warrior.
I find those who believe in the Dark and Light of the Force childish simpletons.
My rejection of Light and Dark has drained me of any real moral compass.
My focus on gaining knowledge has left me with little attachment to people or their feelings.

bondOptions.description: Nothing is more important than the other members of the Blackguard.
I would die to recover an ancient relic that was lost long ago.
I will do anything to protect the temple where I served.
I seek to preserve a sacred text that my enemies consider heretical and seek to destroy.
I'm still seeking the enlightenment I pursued in joining the Blackguard, and it still eludes me.
I would do anything for the Wilder that trained me.

backgrounds.name: Bodyguard
backgrounds.flavorText: You are a licensed bodyguard, standing by your charge ready to protect them from any threat.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Insight, Investigation, and Perception
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: Your choice of demolitions kit, disguise kit, or security kit
backgrounds.equipment: A set of clandestine clothes, the kit for your chosen tool proficiency, a traumakit, and a belt pouch containing 75 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: There are many reasons as to why you may be guarding someone. It could be that you and your family are in the service of a powerful individual, or that you owe a friend a life debt after they rescued you from some perilous encounter. You may be friends with the ones you protect: You may not. But in any case, your loyalties are unwavering, and your courage speaks for itself.
backgrounds.featureText: As a licensed professional, most law enforcement tend to turn a blind eye when you are involved in altercations. You are rarely detained due to wearing armor and wielding weaponry; in fact, while accompanying your client, it is typically socially acceptable for you to go both armed and armored.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I am overly cautious of all food and drink that either my client or I consume.
I find it hard to leave my client to themselves.
I try to take the safest routes through cities, roads, or passes: I am not a fan of dark alley shortcuts.
If my client's legs were weary in a dangerous area, I would carry them every step of the way.
Even though I am constantly by my client's side, I cannot help but feel alone sometimes.
I often try to make situations sound better than they are to make my client feel more comfortable.
I may be a stick in the mud while I am sober, but I am wilder than a rancor when I am intoxicated.
I form attachments to those I care about, and often find myself going above and beyond to make them happy.

idealOptions.name: Guardian
idealOptions.description: I dedicate my life to defending those who cannot defend themselves (Light)

idealOptions.name: Indifferent
idealOptions.description: I do not have personal connections with my charge. They are merely part of the job. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Determined
idealOptions.description: I will protect those who I must... by any means necessary. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Underhanded
idealOptions.description: I will learn my clients' weaknesses so that I may take advantage of them. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Resolute
idealOptions.description: I follow the law laid down for me to protect those whom I am ordered to. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Flexible
idealOptions.description: I take into account my past experiences to help prepare for the future endeavors. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I have lost clients before. I now find myself detached to prevent future heartache.
I am often times forgetful, much to my client's dismay.
I am very stubborn. It is very nearly impossible to sway my opinions on how things should be handled.
Trust is a rare commodity in my line of work. As such, it is not something I often give to others.
My client and I don't get along in the slightest. It makes it quite difficult to want to look after them.
Although I am sworn to protect my client, I will abandon them in the face of certain death.

bondOptions.description: I have a home I love somewhere, though I rarely see it.
I am part of an order dedicated to protecting others.
The one who I look after saved me from something horrible once: I owe them everything.
I have other friends in this business who don't perform their duties exactly how I do.
While that time is behind me now, the faces from my past still linger.
My client isn't the only one who I should protect. There are many more out there without protection.

backgrounds.name: City Watch
backgrounds.flavorText:
You have served the community where you grew up, standing as its first line of defense against crime and wildlife. You aren't a soldier, directing your gaze outward at possible enemies. Instead, your service to your hometown was to help police its populace, protecting the citizenry from lawbreakers and malefactors of every stripe.

Even if you're not city-born or city-bred, this background can describe your early years as a member of law enforcement. Most settlements of any size have their own law enforcement forces.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Insight, Investigation, and Perception
backgrounds.equipment: A uniform in the style of your unit and indicative of your rank, a horn with which to summon help, a set of binders, and a pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Years of service in the City Watch have led to the rigid discipline most often seen in military service. Working with your comrades has created a strong family bond and pride in your community.
backgrounds.featureText: Your experience in enforcing the law, and dealing with lawbreakers, gives you a feel for local laws and criminals. You can easily find the local outpost of the watch or a similar organization, and just as easily pick out the dens of criminal activity in a community, although you're more likely to be welcome in the former locations rather than the latter.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I'm always polite and respectful.
I'm haunted by memories of war. I can't get the images of violence out of my mind.
I've lost too many friends, and I'm slow to make new ones.
I'm full of inspiring and cautionary tales from my guard service relevant to almost every combat situation.
I can stare down a hell hound without flinching.
I enjoy being strong and like breaking things.
I have a crude sense of humor.
I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success.

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: Our lot is to lay down our lives in defense of others. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Responsibility
idealOptions.description: I do what I must and obey just authority. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Independence
idealOptions.description: When people follow orders blindly, they embrace a kind of tyranny. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: In life as in war, the stronger force wins. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: Ideals aren't worth killing over or going to war for. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Nation
idealOptions.description: My city, nation, or people are all that matter. (Any)

flawOptions.description: The monstrous enemy we faced in battle still leaves me quivering with fear.
I have little respect for anyone who is not a proven warrior.
I made a terrible mistake in battle cost many lives� and I would do anything to keep that mistake secret.
My hatred of my enemies is blind and unreasoning.
I obey the law, even if the law causes misery.
I'd rather eat my armor than admit when I'm wrong.

bondOptions.description: I would still lay down my life for the people I served with.
Someone saved my life on the battlefield. To this day, I will never leave a friend behind.
My honor is my life.
I'll never forget the crushing defeat my company suffered or the enemies who dealt it.
Those who fight beside me are those worth dying for.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.

backgrounds.name: Clone
backgrounds.flavorText: You are a miracle of science. A creature born not from love or passion, but from logic and machinery. Created in a laboratory, you are a perfect genetic replica of your DNA-Donor, whomever that is.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
The background of your DNA-Donor often shapes a clone's path in life.

|d20|Donor's Background|
|:---:|:-----------:|
|1|Agent|
|2|Bounty Hunter|
|3|Criminal|
|4|Entertainer|
|5|Force Adept|
|6|Gambler|
|7|Investigator|
|8|Jedi|
|9|Mandalorian|
|10|Mercenary|

|d20|Donor's Background |
|:---:|:-----------:|
|11|Noble|
|12|Nomad|
|13|Outlaw|
|14|Pirate|
|15|Scientist|
|16|Scoundrel|
|17|Sith|
|18|Smuggler|
|19|Soldier|
|20|Spacer|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Lore, Sleight of Hand and Survival
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: Your choice of geneticist's implements, security kit, or slicer's kit
backgrounds.equipment: A set of clothes appropriate to your duties, a trinket related to your DNA-donor, and 150 credits
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: A clone's demeanor often, though not always, matches that of their DNA-Donor. Is it nature, or is it nurture?
backgrounds.featureText: Being a clone, you were born from the existence of another. Flashes of deeds you never did, of people you have never met and of information you have never learned sporadically appear. You may be confused with your DNA-Donor by others, being befriended by, or made enemies of, people you have never before met. The exact nature of these revelations depends on the nature of your DNA-Donor; they might lead to a site that only one other has ever seen, some long-forgotten fact, relic or weapon from the past that could reshape the present, or even information that would be damaging to the people who created you.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I speak rarely but mean every word I say.
I laugh loudly and see the humor in stressful situations.
I prefer to solve problems without violence, but I finish fights decisively.
I enjoy being out in nature; poor weather never sours my mood.
I am dependable.
I am always working on some project or other.
I'm always picking things up, absently fiddling with them, and sometimes accidentally breaking them.
I bluntly say what others are hinting at or hiding.

idealOptions.name: Charity
idealOptions.description: I always try to help those in need, no matter what the personal cost. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Logic
idealOptions.description: Emotions must not cloud our sense of what is right and true, or our logical thinking. (Lawful)|

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: Meddling in the affairs of others only causes trouble. (Balanced)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who would forge them. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Pride
idealOptions.description: I will do whatever it takes to be recognized as the best. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I'm determined to make something of myself. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I secretly believe that everyone is beneath me.
I write exceptionally bad poetry and recite it at inopportune times.
I struggle with individuality, those who see me as unique I would die for.
Every social situation I'm in seems to lead to my asking rude personal questions.
I have trouble trusting in my allies.
I invest so much time into planning that I can't bring myself to deviate from the plan, even when it is needed.

bondOptions.description: I am fiercely loyal to those with whom I work.
In my birth laboratory, I discovered something that could endanger the world.
I spend money freely and live life to the fullest, knowing that tomorrow I might die.
I live for the thrill of the hunt.
I owe my instructor a great debt for forging me into the person I am today.
One day I will return to my home planet and prove that I am their greatest creation.

backgrounds.name: Clone Trooper
backgrounds.flavorText: You are one of millions; genetically engineered, identical specimens designed to be the perfect soldier. Created from a template provided by the legendary bounty hunter Jango Fett, you represent the latest and greatest evolution in galactic warfare.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
While most clones serve as simple soldier, there are many specialized units. Roll a d8 or choose from the options in the table below to determine your specialization:

|d8|Specialization|
|:--:|:--|
|1|Trooper|
|2|Commando|
|3|Jet Trooper|
|4|Medic|

|d8|Specialization|
|:--:|:--|
|5|Spec Ops|
|6|Ordnance|
|7|Officer|
|8|Scout|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Medicine, Perception, and Piloting
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: Your choice of demolitions kit, security kit, or slicer's kit
backgrounds.equipment: Badge or emblem of your rank, your chosen tools, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Clones are trained from birth to be the perfect soldier; over time, they also develop their own personalities. They are universally loyal to the Republic. While clones share genetic coding, no two are completely identical.
backgrounds.featureText: You are a soldier of the Republic. Those loyal to the Republic will respect your status and defer to you if they don't outrank you. You can invoke your position to exert influence over other soldiers, requisition simple equipment, and gain access to military compounds affiliated with the Republic.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I always respect my commander.
I can stare down a krayt dragon without flinching.
I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success.
I have a sense of humor. This is rare among my brothers.
I judge people by their actions, not their words.
I've lost too many friends, and I'm slow to make new ones.
I ask a lot of questions.
I'll settle for nothing less than perfection.

idealOptions.name: Responsibility
idealOptions.description: I do what I must and obey just authority. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: Strength, not compassion, wins battles. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Republic
idealOptions.description: My brothers, the Republic, or people are all that matter. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: We fight not for ourselves, but for countless of others that can't fight for themselves. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Tyrants must not be allowed to oppress the people. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: Ideals aren't worth killing or going to war over. (Neutral)

flawOptions.description: I have little respect for anyone who is of a lesser rank.
I obey orders without question, even if the orders cause misery.
I'd rather eat my armor than admit when I'm wrong.
I judge others harshly, and myself even more severely.
I am inflexible in my thinking.
I can't tell a lie for the life of me.

bondOptions.description: My honor is my life.
Someone saved my life on the battlefield. To this day, I will never leave a friend behind.
Those who fight beside me are those worth dying for.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.
I would still lay down my life for the people I serve with.
A proud commander once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any bully I encounter.

backgrounds.name: Companion
backgrounds.flavorText: You are experienced in the arts of companionship, and you provide these services for people who can afford to pay it. This may mean adult favors of the sensual variety, but it just as frequently means conversation, comfort, and company.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Acrobatics, Deception, Insight, and Performance
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: One instrument of your choice or a disguise kit
backgrounds.equipment: A set of common clothes, an instrument or disguise kit, and a belt pouch containing 50 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: You enjoy people and you enjoy your work and you enjoy the money it brings. There is no shame in your profession and it is often highly regulated and regimented by factions or the local government. It requires outgoing and adventurous personalities to be a success, and often these traits lead them to adventures of a different sort.
backgrounds.featureText: You have or can gain compromising information about people of importance. You may be able to leverage this information in order to acquire lodging, information, or even money.  You may also become a target for having this information. Your GM may rule that any particular individual is either above reproach or is too careful in covering their tracks to provide such leverage.

personalityTraitOptions.description: People are often hurt and damaged. I try to heal them and leave them stronger than when I meet them.
I enjoy being in control and manipulating people. It's important that they like me so they do what I say.
I'm not a laser-brain, although I don't open my mouth to prove people wrong. I let them discover the truth after I have what I want.
I'm better than those who are more prim and proper, and I'm having more fun.
I don't really care what happens, it's an easy way to get money for my habit.
There are so many different kinds of people, and I want to meet them all.
I never thought this was the life for me, perhaps some brave person will rescue me.
I like what I do and I resent those who want to rescue me.

idealOptions.name: Sacred
idealOptions.description: My body is a temple I am duty-bound to share. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Hedonism
idealOptions.description: I fill my urges when and where I wish. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Loving
idealOptions.description: Everyone needs attention and love. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Exploitation
idealOptions.description: I take pleasure in toying with people, and taking advantage of them. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Consent
idealOptions.description: I respect other's desires and wishes. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: I want to have the independence to enjoy life. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I have an incurable disease I acquired from a client.
I am addicted to recreational drugs that dull the pain I feel.
I no longer practice my old profession, and I fear anyone discovering it.
I am suspicious of anyone who tries to be nice to me. They only want me to sleep with them.
Most people are naive children.
I pretend to be tough, but am broken inside.

bondOptions.description: I seek a relationship with the most powerful people in the land, desiring to be the power behind the throne.
If I can only collect enough credits, I'll be able to pay off my debts and be free.
I have a sick parent to whom I send all my money.
My independence is the most important thing in my world.
I bring happiness to the world one person at a time.
I have a young child who is my world.

backgrounds.name: Courtier
backgrounds.flavorText:
In your earlier days, you were a personage of some significance in a noble court or a bureaucratic organization. You might or might not come from an upper-class family; your talents, rather than the circumstances of your birth, could have secured you this position.

You might have been one of the many functionaries, attendants, and other hangers-on in Coruscant's upper echelons, or perhaps you traveled in Nar Shaddaa's baroque and sometimes cutthroat conglomeration of factions, nobles, adventurers, and secret societies. You might have been one of the behind-the-scenes law-keepers or functionaries on Dromund Kaas, or you might have grown up on some other affluent planet.

Even if you are no longer a full-fledged member of the group that gave you your start in life, your relationships with your former fellows can be an advantage for you and your adventuring comrades. You might undertake missions with your new companions that further the interest of the organization that gave you your start in life. In any event, the abilities that you honed while serving as a courtier will stand you in good stead as an adventurer.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Insight, Performance, and Survival
backgrounds.equipment: A set of fine clothes and a pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: The noble court or bureaucratic organization where you got your start is directly or indirectly associated with your bond (which could pertain to certain individuals in the group, such as your sponsor or mentor). Your ideal might be concerned with the prevailing philosophy of your court or organization.
backgrounds.featureText: Your knowledge of how bureaucracies function lets you gain access to the records and inner workings of any noble court or government you encounter. You know who the movers and shakers are, whom to go to for the favors you seek, and what the current intrigues of interest in the group are.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I believe that anything worth doing is worth doing right. I can't help it� I'm a perfectionist.
I'm a snob who looks down on those who can't appreciate fine art.
I always want to know how things work and what makes people tick.
I'm full of witty aphorisms and have a proverb for every occasion.
I'm rude to people who lack my commitment to hard work and fair play.
I like to talk at length about my profession.
I don't part with my money easily and will haggle tirelessly to get the best deal possible.
I'm well known for my work, so I'm always taken aback when people haven't heard of me.

idealOptions.name: Community
idealOptions.description: It is the duty of all civilized people to strengthen the bonds of community and the security of civilization. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Generosity
idealOptions.description: My talents were given to me so that I could use them to benefit the world. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Everyone should be free to pursue his or her own livelihood. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: I'm only in it for the money. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: People
idealOptions.description: I'm committed to the people I care about, not to ideals. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I work hard to be the best there is at my craft. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I'll do anything to get my hands on something rare or priceless.
I'm quick to assume that someone is trying to cheat me.
No one must ever learn that I once stole money from faction coffers.
I'm never satisfied with what I have� I always want more.
I would kill to acquire a noble title.
I'm horribly jealous of anyone who can outshine my handiwork. Everywhere I go, I'm surrounded by rivals.

bondOptions.description: The location where I learned my trade is the most important place in the world to me.
I created a great work for someone unworthy to receive it. I'm still looking for someone worthy.
I owe someone a great debt for forging me into the person I am today.
I pursue wealth to secure someone's love.
One day I will return to my faction and prove that I am the greatest artisan of them all.
I will get revenge on the Dark forces that destroyed my place of business and ruined my livelihood.

backgrounds.name: Crime Lord
backgrounds.flavorText: Few societies manage to eradicate crime altogether. In the underworld, someone always rises to the top, either through vision, organisation, or sheer intimidation. The life of a crime lord isn't for the timid. After conquering an unseen empire, the crime lord wages a daily struggle not only to stay on top, but also to stay alive.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
Not every crime lord is bent on corrupting society and making a profit. Some use their criminal connections to wage guerilla wars against tyrants and despots. Indeed, some historical heroes began as smugglers or pirates, rising through the ranks of their organization to provide a more noble direction for their group's activities. Although some did so to remove an obstacle to making more money, others recognized that ridding the galaxy of evil is a more important long-term goal. Choose the motivation behind your criminal enterprise, or roll on the table below.

|d8|Motivation|
|:---:|:----------:|
|1|Desperation|
|2|Freedom|
|3|Infamy|
|4|Love|

|d8|Motivation|
|:---:|:----------:|
|5|Malice|
|6|Profit|
|7|Respect|
|8|Revenge|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Insight, Intimidation, and Persuasion
backgrounds.equipment: A fine set of clothes, a gaming set (one of your choice), and a purse containing 250 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Crime lords might seem like villains on the surface, and many of them are villainous to the core. But some have an abundance of endearing, if not redeeming, characteristics. Unlike common thieves, some crime lords even have some respect for law and authority, with whom they play a cat-and-mouse type game.
backgrounds.featureText: You have access to an extensive network of organised crime. You know how to get messages to and from local contacts, even over great distances; you know the local messengers, corrupt caravan masters, and seedy sailors who can deliver messages for you.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I always have a plan for what to do when things go wrong.
I am always calm, no matter what the situation. I never raise my voice or let me emotions control me.
My eloquent flattery makes everyone I talk to feel like the most wonderful and important person in the world.
I would rather make a new friend than a new enemy.
I don't like to get my hands dirty, and I won't be caught dead in unsuitable accommodations.
My favor, once lost, is lost forever.
If you do me an injury, I will crush you, ruin your name, and salt your fields.
I blow up at the slightest insult.

idealOptions.name: Honor
idealOptions.description: I don't steal from others in the trade. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who would forge them. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Charity
idealOptions.description: I steal from the wealthy so that I can help people in need. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: People
idealOptions.description: I'm loyal to my friends, not to any ideals, and everyone else can take a walk for all I care. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Redemption
idealOptions.description: There's a spark of good in everyone. (Light)

flawOptions.description: I secretly believe that everyone is beneath me.
When faced with a choice between money and my friends, I usually choose the money.
I too often hear veiled insults and threats in every word addressed to me, and I'm quick to anger.
I have a �tell� that reveals when I'm lying.
I turn tail and run when things look bad.
An innocent person is in prison for a crime that I committed. I'm okay with that.

bondOptions.description: I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a generous benefactor.
My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.
Something important was taken from me, and I aim to steal it back.
The common folk must see me as a hero of the people.
I'm guilty of a terrible crime. I hope I can redeem myself for it.
Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made. That will never happen again.

backgrounds.name: Dathomir Witch
backgrounds.flavorText: You are a part of one of the many Force-sensitive clans on Dathomir. You and your sisters, under the guidance of the Clan Mother, form powerful connections with one another and the untamed wilds of the planet. Your people are a matriarchal society of warriors who train in the art of war and the usage of both muscle and the Force in combat. While all clans have their own set of rules regarding Force usage, all the clans held one rule above all others: *"Never Concede to Evil."*
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
Dathomir culture is built on the backbone of various clans. The clan you are a part of has it's own history, allegiances, and feuds which shape your persepctive. Choose an option or roll on the table below to determine your clan.

|d8|Clan|
|:---:|:----------:|
|1|Singing Mountain|
|2|Misty Falls|
|3|Red Hills|
|4|Dreaming River|

|d8|Clan|
|:---:|:----------:|
|5|Frenzied River|
|6|Great Canyon|
|7|Nightsisters|
|8|Nightbrothers|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Lore, and Nature
backgrounds.equipment: A copy of your clan's book of laws, a set of traveler's clothes, and a pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Dathomir Witches are shaped by their training. They study their book of laws and use it to uphold order and prevent one's turn to the dark side. Their clan and the people around them affects their mannerisms and ideals. Their flaws might be some hidden hypocrisy or heretical idea, or an ideal or bond taken to an extreme.
backgrounds.featureText: Other Dathomir Witches know, and will look out for you. If you're ever in need of a place to stay, or a meal to eat, other Dathomir Witches will help you as long as your clans aren't feuding. This could be in the form of shelters, meals, even healing. If the Dathomir Witches are of your clan or a clan friendly to you, they may be willing to help you even at cost to themselves.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I try and bring my culture to outsiders.
I always put my clan first.
I follow my clan's book of law to the letter.
I once ran twenty-five miles without stopping to warn my clan of an approaching rival clan. I'd do it again if I had to.
I place no stock in wealthy or well-mannered folk. Credits and manners won't save you from a hungry rancor.
I have a lesson for every situation, drawn from observing nature.
I feel far more comfortable around wildlife than I do society.
I'm always picking things up, absently fiddling with them, and sometimes accidentally breaking them.

idealOptions.name: Change
idealOptions.description: Life is like the seasons, in constant change, and we must change with it. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: It is each person's responsibility to make the most happiness for the whole clan. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Honor
idealOptions.description: If I dishonor myself, I dishonor my whole clan. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: The strongest are meant to rule. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Nature
idealOptions.description: The natural world is more important than all the constructs of civilization. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Glory
idealOptions.description: I must earn glory in battle, for myself and my clan. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I stick to my traditions no matter what, even at the cost of others.
There's no room for caution in a life lived to the fullest.
I remember every insult I've received and nurse a silent resentment toward anyone who's ever wronged me.
I am slow to trust members of other species, clans, and societies.
Violence is my answer to almost any challenge.
Don't expect me to save those who can't save themselves. It is nature's way that the strong thrive and the weak perish.

bondOptions.description: My family and clan is the most important thing in my life, even when they are far from me.
An injury to the unspoiled wilderness of my home is an injury to me.
I am the last of my clan, and it is up to me to keep the traditions of my ancestors alive.
It is my duty to provide children to sustain my clan.
I suffer awful visions of a coming disaster and will do anything to prevent it.
I will bring terrible wrath down on those who disrespect my clan.

backgrounds.name: Ex-Cultist
backgrounds.flavorText: Once you served alongside your fellow neophytes. You worshiped at altars to a deific entity, performed the sacraments and adorned yourself in the proper fashion. You basked in this dark glory with your fellows as you served this higher, malign power. But, something changed. Now, you wander the world outside of isolated circle of brethren, either unwillingly or of your own volition.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
Why did you walk away from the world you knew? Was this a choice you made, or did fate separate you from your fellow devotees? Do you wish to undo the evil that your cult perpetuated, or would you rejoin your cult if given the chance? 

|d4|Change of Heart|
|:---:|:----------:|
|1|I witnessed a particularly gruesome rite and ran for my life.|
|2|I asked the wrong kind of questions. The others planned to sacrifice me to our dark lord, but I escaped.|
|3|The others took their own lives to ascend. I could not.|
|4|I no longer believed in what we were doing. It seemed wrong, somehow.|

flavorOptions.name: I witnessed a particularly gruesome rite and ran for my life.
I asked the wrong kind of questions. The others planned to sacrifice me to our dark lord, but I escaped.
The others took their own lives to ascend. I could not.
I no longer believed in what we were doing. It seemed wrong, somehow.

backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Intimidation, Investigation, or Lore
backgrounds.equipment: A set of common clothes including a robe, a symbol of devotion, a copy of a blasphemous holy text, a curved ritual knife, a poisoner's kit, and a belt pouch containing 50 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: A cult washes away all doubt and instills faith throughout a cultist's life. Even if a service is forsworn, members are still deeply affected by their old life.
backgrounds.featureText: You know the secret symbology of your cult, which can pop up in some surprising places. With a subtle gesture or knowing handshake you can discern who follows the ways of your dark lord. Cloisters of your cult may be hidden across the galaxy, identified by the secret signs and symbols designed to lead the faithful to places of dark worship. Such cloistered often contain enough lodging and food for at least ten people, for a week, and sometimes harbor eldritch treasures belonging to the cult.

personalityTraitOptions.description: Everything is a sign of coming doom. Every. Single. Thing.
The world is so exciting! Now I can do things previously forbidden like drinking wine or wearing shoes.
The dark lord used to order us to do everything. It's a little hard for me to live without that.
If my friends will let me, I'll openly reminisce about my old days in the cult all day long.
I can't help but check the holy scriptures for advice about any given situation.
It's not the end of the world. That's not for another five years, three months, ten days, twelve hours...
I hate my cult for what they made me do and what they made me become.
I'll happily inform those I meet of the many ways in which they are being heretical.

idealOptions.name: Loyalty
idealOptions.description: My new companions are my new family, I will protect them. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Redemption
idealOptions.description: I must fix the evils my cult has done. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Independence
idealOptions.description: I'll never be bound in servitude again! (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Power
idealOptions.description: The dark lord was weak in the end. I will be stronger than they ever were. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Secrets
idealOptions.description: The lore of my cult is historically important, and I should preserve it. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Revision
idealOptions.description: The cult failed because the holy book was wrong. I must learn about the outside world, and fix the book's errors. (Any)

flawOptions.description: If I ever had the chance, I'd definitely rejoin my cult.
I'm a little too into blood sacrifice.
Knowledge is more important than sanity.
I'm often more interested in than frightened of abominable eldritch monsters.
I'm almost too willing to follow orders without thinking.
Murder was significantly less frowned upon by the cult than in the outside world.

bondOptions.description: I must discover the truth behind my dark lord, even if it kills me.
I need to reconnect with the people from my life before the cult, if I can ever find them.
I must free other people from unwitting service to dark masters.
A monstrous, immortal guardian of the cult is hunting me. I pray it never finds me.
I sacrificed my light in service to the dark lord, and now I seek to reclaim it.
The day of reckoning is coming, and my knowledge is the key to stopping it.

backgrounds.name: Faction Adventurer
backgrounds.flavorText: Adventuring is nothing new to you. Due to the circumstances of how you were raised, you have been involved with wandering heroes for most of your life. Maybe you were part of an adventuring band previously, but split with them after a disagreement or tragedy. Or, perhaps you worked around heroes in a lesser role for most of your young life, and you are now ready to graduate to the front lines.
backgrounds.flavorDescription: You have either been adventuring or assisting other in adventuring since a very young age. Perhaps your parents were famous adventurers, or a group of adventurers found and raised you as their own. Perhaps you were trained to be a professional monster hunter, or maybe another faction member saved your life so you swore loyalty to them. Work with your GM to determine the nature of your adventuring.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Investigation, Nature, and Survival
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: Your choice demolitions kit, security kit, or slicer's kit
backgrounds.equipment: 50 feet of rope, a small knife, a trophy, a set of traveler's clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr.
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Adventurers are well adjusted to life on the road. They are often comfortable doing dangerous things like dungeoneering and fighting and can stay level-headed in the face of danger, but they may not be so well adapted to other parts of life.
backgrounds.featureText:
You are an established and respected member of an adventurer's faction, allowing you to rely on certain benefits that membership provides. If you are in a town with a headquarters for your adventurer's faction and you are in good standing with the faction, you will be allowed to look at the job postings and find adventuring work to earn money. 

factions often wield tremendous political power. If you are accused of a crime, your faction will support you if a good case can be made for your innocence or the crime is justifiable. You can also gain access to powerful political figures through the faction, if you are a member in good standing. You must pay dues of 50 cr per month to the faction. Your dues must be current to remain in the faction's good graces.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I can't bring myself to ignore a cry for help.
I hold onto every mildly interesting item I find, in case it comes in handy someday.
After all the weirdness I've seen on my travels, nothing can surprise me.
I spit and laugh in the face of danger.
Giving up is never an option for me.
I feel more at home in monster-infested dungeons than in civilized society.
I fill silence with wacky stories about my past misadventures, which may or may not be exaggerated.
My sense of humor is as dark and grim as the dungeons I explore.

idealOptions.name: Adventure
idealOptions.description: All I want is to travel the world and see amazing things. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Heroism
idealOptions.description: I am dedicated to helping people in need. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Order
idealOptions.description: I use my power to save the world from the forces of destruction and chaos. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Excitement
idealOptions.description: An ordinary life is boring, I'd rather travel around and find trouble. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Power
idealOptions.description: The more powerful enemies I defeat, the stronger I become. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I want to go down in history as a brave, powerful hero. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I default to solving problems with violence even when it's unwise or immoral.
I expect to be lavished with praise whenever I do my job, and I get mad when no one acknowledges me.
All members of "Dark" species must be Dark, so I will never trust them.
Waiting around makes me antsy. I'd rather do something stupid than do nothing at all.
My habit of looting dungeons makes me swipe things I shouldn't.
A monstrous enemy I faced in the past still leaves me quivering with fear.

bondOptions.description: I carry with me a strange artifact that I found in a dungeon, but I don't know what it's for.
My adventuring party means the world to me.
I have sworn to hunt down the monster or villain who killed my former adventuring party.
I adventure in order to bring honor (or money) to my family.
There is a faraway place I've always wanted to visit, and I won't stop until I make it there.
All I want is to make the ones who trained me in the way of adventuring proud.

backgrounds.name: Faction Artisan
backgrounds.flavorText: You are a member of an artisan's faction, skilled in a particular field and closely associated with other artisans. You are a well-established part of the mercantile world, freed by talent and wealth from the constraints of a feudal social order. You learned your skills as an apprentice to a master artisan, under the sponsorship of your faction, until you became a master in your own right.
backgrounds.flavorDescription: factions are generally found in cities large enough to support several artisans practicing the same trade. However, your faction might instead be a loose network of artisans who each work in a different village within a larger realm. Work with your GM to determine the nature of your faction.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Insight, Persuasion, and Technology
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: One type of artisan's implements, biochemist's kit, or chef's kit
backgrounds.equipment: A set of tools (one of your choice), a letter of introduction from your faction, a set of traveler's clothes, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: faction artisans are among the most ordinary people in the world�until they set down their tools and take up an adventuring career. They understand the value of hard work and the importance of community, but they're vulnerable to sins of greed and covetousness.
backgrounds.featureText:
As an established and respected member of a faction, you can rely on certain benefits that membership provides. Your fellow faction members will provide you with lodging and food if necessary, and pay for your funeral if needed. In some cities and towns, a factionhall offers a central place to meet other members of your profession, which can be a good place to meet potential patrons, allies, or hirelings.

factions often wield tremendous political power. If you are accused of a crime, your faction will support you if a good case can be made for your innocence or the crime is justifiable. You can also gain access to powerful political figures through the faction, if you are a member in good standing. You must pay dues of 50 cr per month to the faction. Your dues must be current to remain in the faction's good graces.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I believe that anything worth doing is worth doing right. I can't help it� I'm a perfectionist.
I'm a snob who looks down on those who can't appreciate fine art.
I always want to know how things work and what makes people tick.
I'm full of witty aphorisms and have a proverb for every occasion.
I'm rude to people who lack my commitment to hard work and fair play.
I like to talk at length about my profession.
I don't part with my money easily and will haggle tirelessly to get the best deal possible.
I believe I'm well known for my work, and I'm always taken aback when people haven't heard of me.

idealOptions.name: Community
idealOptions.description: It is the duty of all civilized people to strengthen the bonds of community and the security of civilization. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Generosity
idealOptions.description: My talents were given to me so that I could use them to benefit the world. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Everyone should be free to pursue his or her own livelihood. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: I'm only in it for the money. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: People
idealOptions.description: I'm committed to the people I care about, not to ideals. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I work hard to be the best there is at my craft. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I'll do anything to get my hands on something rare or priceless.
I'm quick to assume that someone is trying to cheat me.
No one must ever learn that I once stole money from faction coffers.
I'm never satisfied with what I have� I always want more.
I would kill to acquire a noble title.
I'm horribly jealous of anyone who can outshine my handiwork. Everywhere I go, I'm surrounded by rivals.

bondOptions.description: The workshop where I learned my trade is the most important place in the world to me.
I created a great work for someone, and then found them unworthy of it; I now search for someone worthy.
I owe my faction a great debt for forging me into the person I am today.
I pursue wealth to secure someone's love.
One day I will return to my faction and prove that I am the greatest artisan of them all.
I will get revenge on the Dark forces that destroyed my place of business and ruined my livelihood.

backgrounds.name: Faction Merchant
backgrounds.flavorText: Instead of an artisans' faction, you might belong to a faction of traders, caravan masters, or shopkeepers. You don't craft items yourself but earn a living by buying and selling the works of others. Your faction might be a large merchant consortium (or family) with interests across the galaxy. Perhaps you transported goods from one place to another, by ship, wagon, or caravan, or bought them from traveling traders and sold them in your own little shop. In some ways, the traveling merchant's life lends itself to adventure far more than the life of an artisan.
backgrounds.flavorDescription: factions are generally found in cities large enough to support several artisans practicing the same trade. However, your faction might instead be a loose network of artisans who each work in a different village within a larger realm. Work with your GM to determine the nature of your faction.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Deception, Insight, Performance, and Persuasion
backgrounds.equipment: A letter of introduction from your faction, a set of traveler's clothes, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: faction merchants are among the most ordinary people in the world�until they abscond to take up an adventuring career. They understand the value of hard work and the importance of community, but they're vulnerable to sins of greed and covetousness.
backgrounds.featureText:
As an established and respected member of a faction, you can rely on certain benefits that membership provides. Your fellow faction members will provide you with lodging and food if necessary, and pay for your funeral if needed. You can also gain access to powerful political figures through the faction, if you are a member in good standing. You must pay dues of 50 cr per month to the faction. Your dues must be current to remain in the faction's good graces.

I'm a snob who looks down on those who can't appreciate fine art.
I always want to know how things work and what makes people tick.
I'm full of witty aphorisms and have a proverb for every occasion.
I'm rude to people who lack my commitment to hard work and fair play.
I like to talk at length about my profession.
I don't part with my money easily and will haggle tirelessly to get the best deal possible.
I believe I'm well known for my work, and I'm always taken aback when people haven't heard of me.

idealOptions.description: Everyone should be free to pursue his or her own livelihood. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: I'm only in it for the money. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: People
idealOptions.description: I'm committed to the people I care about, not to ideals. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Aspiration
idealOptions.description: I work hard to be the best there is at my craft. (Any)

I'm quick to assume that someone is trying to cheat me.
No one must ever learn that I once stole money from faction coffers.
I'm never satisfied with what I have� I always want more.
I would kill to acquire a noble title.
I'm horribly jealous of anyone who can outshine my handiwork. Everywhere I go, I'm surrounded by rivals.
