I commissioned a great work for someone unworthy of it; I now search for someone worthy.
I owe my faction a great debt for forging me into the person I am today.
I pursue wealth to secure someone's love.
One day I will return to my faction and prove that I am the greatest artisan of them all.
I will get revenge on the Dark forces that destroyed my place of business and ruined my livelihood.

backgrounds.name: Far Traveler
backgrounds.flavorText:
Almost all of the common people and other folk that one might encounter throughout the galaxy have one thing in common: they live  their lives without traveling more than a few miles from where they were born.

You aren't one of those folk.

You are from a distant place that few of the common folk realize exists; chances are good that even if some people have heard of your homeland, they know merely the name and maybe a few outrageous stories. 

Although you find some of this land's ways to be strange and discomfiting, you can also be sure that some things its people take for granted will be, to you, new wonders that you've never laid eyes on before. By the same token, you're a person of interest, for good or ill, to those around you almost anywhere you go.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
To determine why you are so far from home, roll on the table below or choose from the options provided. 

|d6|Reason|
|:--:|:--:|
|1|Emissary|
|2|Exile|
|3|Fugitive|

|d6|Reason|
|:--:|:--:|
|4|Pilgrim|
|5|Sightseer|
|6|Wanderer|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Investigation, Perception, and Persuasion
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: One musical instrument or gaming set of your choice
backgrounds.equipment: One set of traveler's clothes, any one musical instrument or gaming set you are proficient with, poorly wrought maps from your homeland, a small piece of jewelry worth 100 cr in the style of your homeland's craftsmanship, and a pouch containing 50 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: The distance you've traveled manifests itself in the way you speak and carry yourself.
backgrounds.featureText: Your foreign nature attracts attention, yielding access to people and places you might not otherwise have, for you and your traveling companions. Noble lords, scholars, and merchant princes, to name a few, might be interested in hearing about your distant homeland and people.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I have different assumptions from those around me concerning personal space, invading others' space in innocence, or reacting to invasion of my own.
I have my own ideas about food, and I find the eating habits of others fascinating, confusing, or revolting.
I have a strong code of honor or sense of propriety that others don't comprehend.
I express affection or contempt in ways that are unfamiliar to others.
I honor my deities through practices that are foreign to this land.
I begin or end my day with small traditional rituals that are unfamiliar to those around me.

idealOptions.name: Open
idealOptions.description: I have much to learn from the kindly folk I meet along my way. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Reserved
idealOptions.description: As someone new to these strange lands, I am cautious and respectful in my dealings. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Adventure
idealOptions.description: I'm far from home, and everything is strange and wonderful! (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Cunning
idealOptions.description: Though I may not know their ways, neither do they know mine, which can be to my advantage. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Inquisitive
idealOptions.description: Everything is new, but I have a thirst to learn. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Suspicious
idealOptions.description: I must be careful, for I have no way of telling friend from foe here. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I am secretly (or not so secretly) convinced of the superiority of my own culture over that of this foreign land.
I pretend not to understand the local language in order to avoid interactions I would rather not have.
I have a weakness for the new intoxicants and other pleasures of this land.
I don't take kindly to some of the actions and motivations of folk different from me.
I consider the adherents of other gods to be deluded innocents at best, or ignorant fools at worst.
I have a weakness for the exotic beauty of the people of these lands.

bondOptions.description: So long as I have this token from my homeland, I can face any adversity in this strange land.
The gods of my people are a comfort to me so far from home.
I hold no greater cause than my service to my people.
My freedom is my most precious possession. I'll never let anyone take it from me again.
I'm fascinated by the beauty and wonder of this new land.
Though I had no choice, I lament having to leave my loved one(s) behind. I ho pe to see them again one day.

backgrounds.name: Farmer
backgrounds.flavorText: You are an experienced farmer, cultivating and harvesting nature for the provision of others. You have spent a lot of time surviving outside population centers, but know how to sell your product either directly or to merchants, legal or otherwise.  Because you deal with commodities, either as input or as produce, you know how to get things done and how to live on razor-thin margins. You have survived up to this point by working long, hard, and smart.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
There are as many kinds of farmers as there are things to harvest. Even farmers who provide for all their own needs have deep experience in one type of farming over others. Choose your harvest, or roll on the table below.

|d8|Harvest|
|:---:|:----------:|
|1|Cereal Crops|
|2|Drug Compounds|
|3|Fibrous Plants|
|4|Herbs & Spices|

|d8|Harvest|
|:---:|:----------:|
|5|Insect Products|
|6|Livestock|
|7|Moisture|
|8|Vegetables|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Animal Handling, Nature, Persuasion, and Technology
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: One instrument and one type of artisan's implements or bioanalysis kit
backgrounds.equipment: A rough instrument you are proficient with, a set of tools (one of your choice), a sturdy knife, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 50 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: A farmer is one of the common people and unusually tied to their home and the land. Most farmers look on their humble origins as a virtue, not a shortcoming, and they are quick to defend their home communities and their values, even if they always longed to leave their rural lives and move to the city.
backgrounds.featureText: Since you are of the common folk, you fit in among them with ease. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I judge people by their actions, not their words.
If someone is in trouble, I'm always ready to lend help.
When I set my mind to something, I follow through no matter what gets in my way.
I have a strong sense of fair play and always try to find the most equitable solution to arguments.
Thinking is for other people. I prefer action.
I misuse long words in an attempt to sound smarter.
I watch over my friends as if they were a litter of newborn pups.
I have a lesson for every situation, drawn from observing nature.

idealOptions.name: Respect
idealOptions.description: People deserve to be treated with dignity and respect. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Honor
idealOptions.description: My word is my bond. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Tyrants must not be allowed to oppress the people. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: Meddling in the affairs of others only causes trouble. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: People
idealOptions.description: I'm loyal to my friends, not to any ideals, and everyone else can take a walk for all I care. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I am too enamored of ale, wine, and other intoxicants.
I remember every insult I've received and nurse a silent resentment toward anyone who's ever wronged me.
I am slow to trust members of other species, planets, and societies.
The tyrant who rules my land will stop at nothing to see me killed.
I turn tail and run when things look bad.
I have a weakness for the vices of the city, especially gambling.

bondOptions.description: I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a generous benefactor.
I worked the land, I love the land, and I will protect the land.
A proud noble once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any bully I encounter.
I wish my childhood sweetheart had come with me to pursue my destiny.
My family, community, or planet is the most important thing in my life, even when they are far from me.
Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made. That will never happen again.

backgrounds.name: Folk Hero
backgrounds.flavorText: You come from a humble social rank, but you are destined for so much more. Already the people of your home village regard you as their champion, and your destiny calls you to stand against the tyrants and monsters that threaten the common folk everywhere.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
You previously pursued a simple profession among the peasantry, perhaps as a farmer or miner, servant or shepherd. But something happened that set you on a different path and marked you for greater things. Choose or randomly determine a defining event that marked you as a hero of the people.

|d8|Defining Event|
|:---:|:----------|
|1|I stood up to a tyrant's agents.|
|2|I saved people during a natural disaster.|
|3|I stood alone against a terrible monster.|
|4|I stole from a corrupt merchant to help the poor.|
|5|I led a militia to fight off an invading army.|
|6|I broke into a tyrant's castle and stole weapons to arm the people.|
|7|I trained the peasantry to use farm implements as weapons against a tyrant's soldiers.|
|8|A lord rescinded an unpopular decree after I led a symbolic act of protect against it.|

flavorOptions.name: I stood up to a tyrant's agents.
I saved people during a natural disaster.
I stood alone against a terrible monster.
I stole from a corrupt merchant to help the poor.
I led a militia to fight off an invading army.
I broke into a tyrant's castle and stole weapons to arm the people.
I trained the peasantry to use farm implements as weapons against a tyrant's soldiers.
A lord rescinded an unpopular decree after I led a symbolic act of protect against it.

backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Animal Handling, Athletics, Nature, and Performance
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: One type of artisan's implements, biochemist's kit, or chef's kit
backgrounds.equipment: A set of tools (one of your choice), a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: A folk hero is one of the common people, for better or for worse. Most folk heroes look on their humble origins as a virtue, not a shortcoming, and their home communities remain very important to them.
backgrounds.featureText: Since you are of the common folk, you fit in among them with ease. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I judge people by their actions, not their words.
If someone is in trouble, I'm always ready to lend help.
When I set my mind to something, I follow through no matter what gets in my way.
I have a strong sense of fair play and always try to find the most equitable solution to arguments.
I'm confident in my own abilities and do what I can to instill confidence in others.
Thinking is for other people. I prefer action.
I misuse long words in an attempt to sound smarter.
I get bored easily. When am I going to get on with my destiny?

idealOptions.name: Respect
idealOptions.description: People deserve to be treated with dignity and respect. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Fairness
idealOptions.description: No one should get preferential treatment before the law, and no one is above the law. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Tyrants must not be allowed to oppress the people. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Might
idealOptions.description: If I become strong, I can take what I want�what I deserve. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Sincerity
idealOptions.description: There's no good in pretending to be something I'm not. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Destiny
idealOptions.description: Nothing and no one can steer me away from my higher calling. (Any)

flawOptions.description: The tyrant who rules my land will stop at nothing to see me killed.
I'm convinced of the significance of my destiny, and blind to my shortcomings and the risk of failure.
The people who knew me when I was young know my shameful secret, so I can never go home again.
I have a weakness for the vices of the city, especially hard drink.
Secretly, I believe that things would be better if I were a tyrant lording over the land.
I have trouble trusting in my allies.

bondOptions.description: I have a family, but I have no idea where they are. One day, I hope to see them again.
I worked the land, I love the land, and I will protect the land.
A proud noble once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any bully I encounter.
My tools are symbols of my past life, and I carry them so that I will never forget my roots.
I protect those who cannot protect themselves.
I wish my childhood sweetheart had come with me to pursue my destiny.

backgrounds.name: Gladiator
backgrounds.flavorText: A gladiator is as much an entertainer as any minstrel or circus performer, trained to make the arts of combat into a spectacle the crowd can enjoy. This kind of flashy combat is your entertainer routine, though you might also have some skills as a tumbler or actor. Using your A Champion Well Known feature, you can find a place to perform in any place that features combat for entertainment�perhaps a gladiatorial arena or secret pit fighting club.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Acrobatics, Athletics, Intimidation, and Performance
backgrounds.equipment: A trophy earned via some sort of competition, clothing suitable to your profession, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Successful entertainers have to be able to capture and hold an audience's attention, so they tend to have flamboyant or forceful personalities. They're inclined toward the romantic and often cling to high-minded ideals about the practice of art and the appreciation of beauty.
backgrounds.featureText: You can always find a place to perform, usually in an inn or tavern but possibly with a circus, at a theater, or even in a noble's court. At such a place, you receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard (depending on the quality of the establishment), as long as you perform each night. In addition, your performance makes you something of a local figure. When strangers recognize you in a town where you have performed, they typically take a liking to you.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I know a story relevant to almost every situation.
Whenever I come to a new place, I collect local rumors and spread gossip.
I'm a hopeless romantic, always searching for that �special someone.�
Nobody stays angry at me or around me for long, since I can defuse any amount of tension.
I love a good insult, even one directed at me.
I get bitter if I'm not the center of attention.
I'll settle for nothing less than perfection.
I change my mood or my mind as quickly as I change key in a song.

idealOptions.name: Beauty
idealOptions.description: When I perform, I make the world better than it was. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Tradition
idealOptions.description: The stories, legends, and songs of the past must never be forgotten, for they teach us who we are. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Creativity
idealOptions.description: The world is in need of new ideas and bold action. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: I'm only in it for the money and fame. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: People
idealOptions.description: I like seeing the smiles on people's faces when I perform. That's all that matters. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Honesty
idealOptions.description: Art should reflect the soul; it should come from within and reveal who we really are. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I'll do anything to win fame and renown.
I'm a sucker for a pretty face.
A scandal prevents me from ever going home again. That kind of trouble seems to follow me around.
I once satirized a noble who still wants my head. It was a mistake that I will likely repeat.
I have trouble keeping my true feelings hidden. My sharp tongue lands me in trouble.
Despite my best efforts, I am unreliable to my friends.

bondOptions.description: My instrument is my most treasured possession, and it reminds me of someone I love.
Someone stole my precious trophy, and someday I'll get it back.
I want to be famous, whatever it takes.
I idolize a hero of the old tales and measure my deeds against that person's.
I will do anything to prove myself superior to my hated rival.
I would do anything for the other members of my old troupe.

backgrounds.name: Hermit
backgrounds.flavorText: You lived in seclusion�either in a community or alone�for a formative part of your life. In your time apart from society, you found quiet, solitude, and perhaps some of the answers you were looking for.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
What was the reason for your isolation, and what changed to allow you to end your solitude? You can work with your GM to determine the exact nature of your seclusion, or you can choose or roll on the table below to determine the reason behind your seclusion.

|d6|Life of Seclusion|
|:---:|:----------:|
|1|I was partaking of communal living in accordance with the dictates of a religious order.|
|2|I retreated from society after a life-altering event.|
|3|I needed a quiet place to work on my art, literature, music, or manifesto.|
|4|I needed to commune with nature, far from civilization.|
|5|I was the caretaker of an ancient ruin or relic.|
|6|I was in search of a place of spiritual significance.|

flavorOptions.name: I was partaking of communal living in accordance with the dictates of a religious order.
I retreated from society after a life-altering event.
I needed a quiet place to work on my art, literature, music, or manifesto.
I needed to commune with nature, far from civilization.
I was the caretaker of an ancient ruin or relic.
I was in search of a place of spiritual significance.

backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Animal Handling, Lore, Medicine, and Nature
backgrounds.equipment: A diary of your experiences, a winter blanket, a set of common clothes, a bioanalysis kit, and 50 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Some hermits are well suited to a life of seclusion, whereas others chafe against it and long for company. Whether they embrace solitude or long to escape it, the solitary life shapes their attitudes and ideals. Some few are driven slightly mad by their isolation.
backgrounds.featureText: The seclusion of your hermitage gave you access to a unique and powerful discovery. The nature of this revelation depends on the nature of your seclusion. You might have discovered a great truth about the cosmos or the Force, a fact that has long been forgotten, a relic of the past that could rewrite history, or a place unseen for ages. It might be information that would be damaging to the people who consigned you to exile, and hence the reason for your return to society. Work with your GM to determine the details of your discovery and its impact on the campaign.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I've been isolated for so long that I rarely speak, preferring gestures and the occasional grunt.
I am utterly serene, even in the face of disaster.
The leader of my community had something wise to say on every topic, and I am eager to share that wisdom.
I feel tremendous empathy for all who suffer.
I'm oblivious to etiquette and social expectations.
I connect everything that happens to me to a grand, cosmic plan.
I often get lost in my own thoughts and contemplation, becoming oblivious to my surroundings.
I am working on a grand philosophical theory and love sharing my ideas.

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: My gifts are meant to be shared with all, not used for my own benefit. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Logic
idealOptions.description: Emotions must not cloud our sense of what is right and true, or our logical thinking. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Free Thinking
idealOptions.description: Inquiry and curiosity are the pillars of progress. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Power
idealOptions.description: Solitude and contemplation are paths toward mystical power. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Live and Let Live
idealOptions.description: Meddling in the affairs of others only causes trouble. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Self-Knowledge
idealOptions.description: If you know yourself, there's nothing left to know. (Any)

flawOptions.description: Now that I've returned to the world, I enjoy its delights a little too much.
I harbor dark, bloodthirsty thoughts that my isolation and meditation failed to quell.
I am dogmatic in my thoughts and philosophy.
I let my need to win arguments overshadow friendships and harmony.
I'd risk too much to uncover a lost bit of knowledge.
I like keeping secrets and won't share them with anyone.

bondOptions.description: Nothing is more important than the other members of my hermitage, order, or association.
I entered seclusion to hide from the ones who might still be hunting me. I must someday confront them.
I'm still seeking the enlightenment I pursued in my seclusion, and it still eludes me.
I entered seclusion because I loved someone I could not have.
Should my discovery come to light, it could bring ruin to the world.
My isolation gave me great insight into a great Dark that only I can destroy.

backgrounds.name: Holonet Technician
backgrounds.flavorText: You worked to keep the holonet up and running, whether being employed directly by an institution or indirectly by people across the galaxy. Your work has allowed you to uncover secrets most would never know existed.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
There are many people who service parts of the holonet, and many more who want to control the flow of information. Choose which best suits your character or roll on the table below.

|d8|Role|
|:---:|:----------:|
|1|Inter-world Government|
|2|Inter-world Corporation|
|3|World Government|
|4|Crime Syndicate|

|d8|Role|
|:---:|:----------:|
|5|Independent Contractor|
|6|Broadcasting Service|
|7|Small Corporation|
|8|Darknet Broadcasting|
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Investigation, Stealth, and Technology
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: Choose two from mechanic's kit, security kit, and slicer's kit
backgrounds.equipment: A set of common clothes, an old transceiver antennae, two tools of your choice, and a belt pouch containing 50 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Holonets technicians vary from boring officer worker to criminal information broker.
backgrounds.featureText: You have the codes to a distributor station which gives you access to all information sent through it. This information comes in the form of useful (and sometimes sensitive) information on a topic you choose each day to tune into; this information isn't always reliable or interesting. Regardless of the quality of the information, it's relevance most likely pertains to your locale.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I watch and record people secretly then review it later.
I talk like I'm on a game show or am a holonet broadcaster at all times.
I prefer to be left to my own devices.
I like to record people dying and upload it to the holonet.
There's no such thing as 'real news'.
Information is a weapon that I've mastered.
I am always interested in learning new things.
I prefer interacting indirectly.

idealOptions.name: Duty
idealOptions.description: It is my duty to keep all people in contact so that everything will continue working as intended. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Autonomy
idealOptions.description: Information is meant to confuse and overwhelm. I choose to control my own mind by controlling what information I have access to. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Happiness
idealOptions.description: The more hope and joy I spread, the more laughs I bring; that is why I do what I do. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Popularity
idealOptions.description: I want to become the most renown being in all the galaxy, and I'll destroy the competition. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Knowledge
idealOptions.description: I don't care who's ideology is right, I care who's ideology will let me learn and document information. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Self-Fulfillment
idealOptions.description: I'm just here for the fun of it, no matter what happens it'll make a great story one day. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I tend to think any broadcaster is a fraud immediately unless they prove otherwise.
I tend to repeat the same mistake unless it is pointed out to me.
I will ramble endlessly about a random holonet broadcast that I saw which I think was the best ever.
I think everyone who works a normal job is a drone without the ability to think freely.
I describe everything using references to obscure holonet recordings.
I've become completely desensitized to violence and graphic imagery, to the point where I laugh in an off putting way whenever I see it.

bondOptions.description: I will do anything to free people from censorship.
I can't let anyone know I work for a crime lord.
I see truth in an ideology, and I must spread that ideal to all.
I got a man killed by giving him a platform to speak, I can't let that happen again.
I�m on the run from a government organization that I spread propaganda against and who's propaganda I destroy.
I have a famous person's private logs, and I don't know what to do with them.

backgrounds.name: Imperial Knight
backgrounds.flavorText:
You are an Imperial Knight, a Force-wielding protector of the Fel Empire. Your order combines the teachings of the Jedi with the creed of the Royal Guard of old, using the Force as a powerful and respected tool with which to serve the Force as embodied by your Emperor. Imperial Knights do not share the philosophies of the Jedi with regards to the Force and its light side, and are well aware of the dangers of the dark side, dutifully rejecting its use and temptations. 

While Imperial Knights wield and construct their own lightsabers, they assign them no ceremonial value, treating them as nothing more than tools. As such, almost all lightsabers of the Imperial Knights look the same, with uniform hilt design and signature silver blades. These blades are produced by synthetic crystals similar to the red variety used by the Sith, created with knowledge from Emperor Palpatine's *Book of Anger*, but in a process bereft of the dark side. Imperial Knights are also recognized by their crimson armor emblazoned with the insignia of the Empire and ideally crafted of lightsaber-resistant materials.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Intimidation, Perception, or Piloting
backgrounds.equipment: a revised copy of the *Book of Anger*, an Imperial insignia, a black cape with a hood, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Imperial Knights are warriors first, not negotiators. Their bonds are shaped by the great value they put in teamwork with their fellow Knights, as well as their loyalty to their Emperor. Their flaws may lie in their hubris, sense of superiority, or overzealousness in banishing the dark side. Some Knights hold ideals that lie beyond their order, for better or worse.
backgrounds.featureText: The authority granted by your position is easily acknowledged even by those who don't recognize the Imperial Knights. Though they might not know you, common citizens will extend you every courtesy and do their utmost to help you. Unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them, they will even take up arms to fight alongside you, should you find yourself facing an enemy alone.

personalityTraitOptions.description: If a crisis comes, my place will be at the Emperor's side.
I dislike my title. It is only there to make me seem more important than I am.
I do not lead. I only advise.
Some things are more important than the life of any one person�including mine.
I will not bend, I will not break, I will not serve.
I will not strike an enemy down in anger.
I can do whatever needs to be done!
I've wanted to test myself against the Sith!

idealOptions.name: Duty
idealOptions.description: We serve with honor and if we are asked to sacrifice our honor as our duty, then we are betrayed. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Loyalty
idealOptions.description: I do not understand, sire. But I will obey. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Faith
idealOptions.description: I will not stray from the true path. I feel the responsibility that comes with wielding the Force now more than ever. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Prudence
idealOptions.description: Where I come from, we at least hear someone out before we shoot them. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Pride
idealOptions.description: We are Imperial Knights. There are none better. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Strategy
idealOptions.description: A tiny fever wasp can carry death into places where a Krayt dragon cannot go. (Any)

flawOptions.description: My passion is my strength�my passion is my weakness. So my Master always told me.
It was by the will of the Force my accident maimed me.
Sometimes we must sacrifice those who need us for the greater good.
The penalty for desertion has always been death.
I envy the freedom of others, but I'm not walking away from my responsibilities.
I can no longer be a Knight. I've become... something else.

bondOptions.description: Our duty is to the Force as embodied by the Emperor.
There is a person I care more about than my vows as a Knight or my loyalty to the Empire.
I might, by strength of my own will, develop my own creations.
I will not allow another who has risen in my defense to be killed!
My friend is not the most orthodox of Knights. I've learned a lot from her.
I had a mentor, who was willing to sacrifice himself for the greater good.

backgrounds.name: Independent Droid
backgrounds.flavorText: You were once a machine, designed for a very specific task, with no mind of your own. You followed orders, never questioning the tasks assigned to you, often the mundane tasks nobles didn't want to waste time doing themselves. However, something happened in your existence that changed your programming, freeing you from your life of obedience.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
You were a machine designed to complete a task and that was exactly what you were going to do.

| d4  | Past Life |
|:-------:|:-----------|
|1|	You were built to be a soldier to fight wars that the ones who designed you caused.|
|2|Once your programming gave you free will, your memories were corrupted, and now you can never remember what purpose you used to serve.|
|3|You were created to be a medic, to keep the living healthy and alive.|
|4|You were made for scholarly tasks, built with the knowledge to teach others skills and history.|

flavorOptions.name: You were built to be a soldier to fight wars that the ones who designed you caused.
Once your programming gave you free will, your memories were corrupted, and now you can never remember what purpose you used to serve.
You were created to be a medic, to keep the living healthy and alive.
You were made for scholarly tasks, built with the knowledge to teach others skills and history.

backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Medicine, Persuasion, or Technology
backgrounds.equipment: Astrotech's implements, one trinket from before you awoke, and a belt pouch containing 50 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: You have grown to accept and even appreciate the event that freed you from a life of servitude. You are alive, and nobody can convince you otherwise. You fight to prove your worth amongst the living, find your place in society, strive to free others of your kind, and show them the same truth you know now.
backgrounds.featureText: When you served under a master, you would often hear secrets that weren't meant for your ears. Back then, however, you weren't alive. You have insider knowledge on your previous owner or perhaps others who passed through your area. This knowledge may be used for leverage, revenge, or other means, at the discretion of your GM. This knowledge, while it may prove useful in your adventure, may also make you a target for those whose secrets you possess.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I strive to be viewed as a peer to living beings.
I despise those that once called me property.
I refuse to be controlled anymore, and I will not allow others of my kind to be stuck in said fate.
I struggle to handle my new emotions, and am prone to sudden emotional outbursts.
I'm always defensive; sarcasm and insults are my weapons of choice.
I feel tremendous sorrow for others like myself who aren't yet free.
I am horribly, horribly awkward in social situations.
I'm used to teaching those of lesser intellect, patiently explaining anything and everything to others.

idealOptions.name: Rules
idealOptions.description: I feel compelled to follow orders and am opposed to breaking the law for any reason. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Revolution
idealOptions.description: I loathe authority with a passion, and refuse to submit to anyone. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Kindness
idealOptions.description: I greet all sentient creatures with kindness and understanding. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Revenge
idealOptions.description: I fight to wreak vengeance upon those who I view have wronged me. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Now that I'm awake, I will do anything and everything to defy what I was made to be. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Life
idealOptions.description: I simply wish to find who I truly am, and be respected as a living being. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I have certain rituals that I must follow every day. I can never break them.
I don't understand emotions and often misread emotional cues.
I take things literally unless the non-literal meaning is explained to me.
I always second guess myself, and cannot get over the notion others are superior to me.
I have trouble keeping my true feelings hidden. My sharp tongue lands me in trouble.
My past deeds haunt me to this day.

bondOptions.description: No one else is going to have to endure the hardships I've been through.
Errors in my programming make me suffer awful visions of disaster that I try to prevent from coming true.
A proud noble once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any nobles I encounter.
I entered seclusion to hide from my creators who might still be hunting me. I must someday confront them.
Everything I do is for others of my kind, and the friends I fight alongside.
I'm guilty of a terrible crime. I hope I can redeem myself for it.

backgrounds.name: Insurgent
backgrounds.flavorText: Have enemies? Good, that means you stood for something at some time in your life. For you, that was taking a stand against the status quo back home. Whether it was against scheming merchant lords or an oppressive autocracy, you made your voice heard to push for change...and perhaps its the reason why you're now adventuring, having left your home to gather allies or flee retribution.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
Every insurgent has a method to their madness when it comes to rebelling against the authorities. Choose a form of protest or roll on the table below.

| d8  | Dissent Method |
|:-------:|:-----------|
|1|I create subversive artwork that I leave in public places.|
|2|I actively vandalize property of my homeland's rulers.|
|3|I agitate the common people to unite against the rulers.|
|4|I work within the system, leaking private information.|
|5|I organize secret meetings of enemies of the state.|
|6|I publish written critiques against the my rulers.|
|7|I investigate and expose corruption in government.|
|8|I publicly condemn the ruling class.|

flavorOptions.name: I create subversive artwork that I leave in public places.
I actively vandalize property of my homeland's rulers.
I agitate the common people to unite against the rulers.
I work within the system, leaking private information.
I organize secret meetings of enemies of the state.
I publish written critiques against the my rulers.
I investigate and expose corruption in government.
I publicly condemn the ruling class.

backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Persuasion, Stealth, or Technology
backgrounds.toolProficiencies: One type of artisan's implements, disguise kit, or forgery kit
backgrounds.equipment: One set of tools in which you are proficient, a set of traveler's clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Insurgents live a life on the move, thinking one step ahead of the their pursuers, whether law enforcement at home or spies abroad. They might be calm in tense situations or stressed by the pressures facing them.
backgrounds.featureText: You are part of a network of fellow insurgents. Although you may not always agree on the methods of dissent with your fellow members, they are willing to create distractions in public, provide safe passage, and inform you of the patrol routes of guards, the military and other law enforcement in the cities and territories in which they are active.

personalityTraitOptions.description: Nothing is immune to criticism, whether the king, the Force, or the price of bread.
I will go out of my way to help the downtrodden and subjugated.
I keep a collection of political writings and posters I find, just in case I need them.
I am hardened in my resolve, no setback, no challenge will break it.
I like to walk through public places and people watch.
People are not entitled to their opinion, they are entitled to their *informed* opinion.
I will  spend a good amount of time rehearsing my talking points and my zingers.
I'm passionate about what I do to the point that I forget the day has finished.

idealOptions.name: Change
idealOptions.description: The status quo is broken and must be reformed. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Morality
idealOptions.description: Those in power have an obligation to help everyone, not just the few. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Justice
idealOptions.description: The law is the law, those in power are not above it. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Power
idealOptions.description: We must overcome doubt and achieve our goals, by any means necessary. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: We must  liberate ourselves from those who would seek to chain us to tradition. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Order
idealOptions.description: Without authority, we fall into disarray. (Lawful)

flawOptions.description: I am certain I am being hunted and am mistrusting towards those who offer me help.
I just *have* to bring up politics at the dinner table.
I view people who won't fight for what they believe in as cowards.
I frequently misrepresent or stereotype those with views different than me.
I struggle to empathize with those who will be hurt by the changes I want to bring.
I adamantly refuse to change my mind and dismiss evidence that contradicts my beliefs.

bondOptions.description: My fellow comrades fighting for change are a second family to me.
An agent of the regime is responsible for all my suffering. I will get my revenge on them one day.
I possess secret information vital to my movement, I cannot let the enemy obtain it.
Despite all of its problems, I love my homeland.
Someone helped me escape certain execution, I owe them my life.
There are letters out there that will help bring down those in power. I will stop at nothing to obtain them.

backgrounds.name: Jensaarai
backgrounds.flavorText:
You are a Jensaarai, a Force user who has come to understand the failings of both Jedi inactivity and Sith malevolence. While they wield lightsabers, a true mark of skill among the Jensaarai is the crafting of their armor. Each suit is perfectly unique to the wearer, and is frequently (but not always) adorned and shaped to represent an animal that the Jensaarai finds kinship with, up to and potentially including additional mounted weapons or sensors to further emulate that creature.

While the Jensaarai train in, and will use dark side powers when necessary, they seek to avoid true corruption. They are not evil, nor are they wholly good either. They are anti-heroes, and well-practiced in this craft. In addition, the Jensaarai train in more than the lightsaber, employing whatever tools are at hand to best fit the job.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Intimidation, Lore, and Perception
backgrounds.equipment: A set of common clothes including a robe, a sturdy knife, and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Jensaarai are shaped by the unique capacity of their upbringing. Their study of the duality of the Force manifests in their mannerisms and ideals. Their bond might be their family or their armor. Their flaws might be some a hatred of the Jedi or Sith or a desire to become one or the other.
backgrounds.featureText:
Due to the corruption of the Jedi training done to the pre-Jensaarai, you have a unique insight into both the Light and Dark side of the Force, as well as its history, applications, and techniques in a scholarly manner.

You are well versed in the above concepts, and can recall key information related to them. However, if the research was hidden from the public and you have not had experience working with it, you can only partially understand it. You also recognize well-known Jedi Masters and Sith Lords by their works and marks.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I ignore the rhetoric a person spouts when meeting them, preferring to judge them by action.
I'm the first to swing a punch, but the last to draw a weapon.
Danger is my middle name.
Goodwill is in short supply in the galaxy, and I always try to foster a little more wherever I go.
Both the Republic and the Empire have tried to crush us under their bootheels. I refuse to yield.
Defiant to the last isn't good enough. Upon death I will become a force spirit and continue to defy my killer.
Well-behaved people rarely make history.
What gave you the idea that I was going to give you a fair fight?

idealOptions.name: Respect
idealOptions.description: Respect will be shown to everyone, disrespect will be shown to those who earn it. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: People should be free to make their own way without interference. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Growth
idealOptions.description: Self-improvement is an unending chore, but one that must be done. (Any)

idealOptions.name: Escalation
idealOptions.description: I will immediately end a hostile situation with all means at my disposal. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Power
idealOptions.description: Given our luck with both Jedi and Sith, I need all I can get. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Redemption
idealOptions.description: There's a spark of good in everyone. (Light)

flawOptions.description: I might be a little too enamored with force choking my enemies.
I am my own worst critic, in everything I do.
My armor is precision crafted and has served me faithfully. I never give up a chance to prove how well.
I have a collection of lightsabers from fallen foes, and I love adding to it.
The Jedi and Sith worship the Force as a religion. I do everything I can to remind them they're just worshipping a hammer.
The minute you tell me that someone should not be crossed, I'm already crossing them.

bondOptions.description: The Jensaarai took me in when nobody else would. I back the order 100%.
I was once a Jedi, but grew disillusioned by their inactivity.
I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.
I lost my mentor in battle. I will honor their sacrifice by destroying their killer.
I was able to slough off Dark Side corruption, but I couldn't avoid making amends.
The powerful use their strength to raise people up, not keep them down.

backgrounds.name: Jizz Wailer
backgrounds.flavorText:
You are one of the grooviest beings in the galaxy. You are a professional musician, versed in the improvisational style of the outer rim known as Jizz. 

Jizz is a melting pot of thousands of different alien musical traditions. Jizz celebrates spontaneity, groove and experimentation. It is almost always played in an ensemble band, but the instruments can vary. Knowing how to play with others, when to push and when to pull back, is the key to a good ensemble.

But Jizz is more than the music. It's about wandering the galaxy and living out of a suitcase. It's about playing the sleaziest cantinas you can find and having a good time while you do it. Jizz is the music of freedom and freedom loving people. Jizz is Life and Life is Jizz.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Performance, Persuasion, and Sleight of Hand
backgrounds.equipment: A musical instrument (one of your choice), a cool hat, a set of common clothes and a belt pouch containing 150 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Its said that if you have to ask what Jizz is, then you'll never know. It doesn't matter where you come from, what matters is if you've got the groove.
backgrounds.featureText: You can always find a place to perform, usually in an cantina or spice den but possibly in a fine dining establishment, culture center or even a noble�s court. At such a place, you receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard (depending on the quality of the establishment), as long as you perform each night. In addition, your performance makes you something of a local figure. When strangers recognize you in a town where you have performed, they typically take a liking to you.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I always wear a cool hat so everyone knows I'm a real Jizz Man.
I constantly hum or whistle tunes.
I'm pioneering a new style, it's gonna blow your mind.
I'm always hustling and looking for the next job.
I have a ridiculous stage name.
I'm always searching for new sounds.
I've played with all the legends and won't shut up about it.
I speak in lyrics, catchphrases and hipster slang.

idealOptions.name: Freedom
idealOptions.description: Jizz is the voice of freedom, a light in the darkness. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Retired
idealOptions.description: I've put my life as a Jizz Wailer behind me, it was a mistake of my youth. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Improvisation
idealOptions.description: Life is like Jizz, its best when you improvise. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Good Times
idealOptions.description: Life is short, we might as well have a good time while it lasts. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Fame
idealOptions.description: I'm gonna be the biggest thing since Max Rebo and Droopy McCool. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Cool
idealOptions.description: If you aren't cool, you might as well be dead. (Any)

flawOptions.description: I blow my money on booze, gambling, pretty companions or some other vice.
Despite being a renowned Jizz Wailer, most people think my music sounds awful.
I'm a flake, I'm always late to rehearsal.
I'm wanted by the Law for my hooliganism.
I owe debts or favors to criminals.
I'm caught up with several lovers and my infidelity causes me problems.

bondOptions.description: My instrument is my most treasured possession, and it reminds me of someone I lost.
I'd do anything for another Jizz Wailer.
A deal is a deal, I never go back on my word.
I'll do whatever it takes to stay in the spotlight.
I'll never sell out, artistic integrity is all I have.
I do it all for the fans, without them I'd be nothing.

I am fiercely independent.

backgrounds.name: Lawyer
backgrounds.flavorText:
Your duty is to uphold the law. Before becoming an adventurer you resided over a court or tribunal, managing proceedings and sentencing criminals to punishments fit for their crimes. Your job required a deep understanding of the law which you used to resolve conflicts both clear-cut and morally grey.

The legal system on the planet where you worked has a large effect on how you view the law. Was it a court system with a jury making the final verdict, or did you have absolute authority over determining guilt and sentencing? Was it a fair legal system with plenty of integrity, or was it rife with abuse and corruption? Did you work on criminal cases, civil law, or something even more specific? Perhaps instead of working for a government you were a judge in an internal tribunal for a temple or military organization. 

Consider what compelled you to leave your old occupation behind and begin adventuring. Perhaps you seek to bring someone beyond the scope of law to justice, or maybe you have lost faith in the legal system altogether and have turned to a vigilante approach.
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Investigation, Performance, and Persuasion
backgrounds.equipment: Documentation of your station, a book of law, a formal uniform you wear to court, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr.
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: A lawyer's career is centered on issues of right, wrong, and punishment, so they will approach adventuring through a similar lens. They are used to being respected and in control, leading many of them to struggle with wild, Any situations.
backgrounds.featureText:
You are familiar with the letter of the law and workings of courts, at least on the planet that you were a judge in. If you are in a foreign place where you are not familiar with their exact laws, you often will be able to track down the resources you need to learn them. 

If you or your party gets into legal trouble, your experience may help you get out of it. If you can prove your credentials, you might be able to represent your party in a court of law without admonishment. You may know of legal loopholes that will help your case. If you are in the region where you originally worked, you might have past connections with many legal professionals there.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I quote the law like a religious fanatic quotes scripture.
I bang my weapon like a gavel whenever I want a rowdy group's attention.
I remain impartial when making decisions, even when I should have biases and loyalties.
Evidence is necessary to back up any claim.
I insist on settling all party disagreements through fake court proceedings.
I have to hear all sides of a story, but I secretly hate listening to people whine about how unfairly they're treated.
I am happy to make sacrifices for the sake of fairness.
I will not attack a person unless someone can prove they are doing something wrong.

idealOptions.name: Law
idealOptions.description: I will follow the letter of the law always, no matter what I believe. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Justice
idealOptions.description: My duty is to fight for the disenfranchised underdog. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Reform
idealOptions.description: Laws can be corrupt, and I strive to free people from the bad ones. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Punishment
idealOptions.description: I will punish all those who have committed great Darks. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Control
idealOptions.description: I enforce the law only where it benefits myself. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Stability
idealOptions.description: The purpose of the law is to keep civilization from collapsing. That spirit of that goal is more important than the letter of the law. (Neutral)

flawOptions.description: Mercy is a foreign concept to me.
I am unwilling to admit when I am wrong.
I become unreasonably enraged at even the slightest injustice.
I expect others to adhere to the law, but I act like i am above it.
If there isn't a law in the books to handle a moral dilemma, I can't make a decision.
The punishments I deal are cruel and unusual.

bondOptions.description: A dangerous criminal is on the loose, and I plan to hunt them down.
All those who strive to uphold the law are my allies.
I have sentenced an innocent man to a horrible punishment, and the guilt still haunts me.
There is an ethical cause that I would give my life for.
I dream of memorizing the laws of every civilization.
I am enamored with the legal system of my own culture, and want to spread its tenets everywhere.

backgrounds.name: Office Worker
backgrounds.flavorText: You are an experienced office worker, having been employed by one or more local, planetary, or galactic governments, or one or more private enterprises or syndicates.  You have spent plenty of time around the water cooler and still have contacts in the governmental and corporate worlds.  Love them or hate them, you know your way around rules and regulations and you function well in structured environments.

I am always calm, no matter what the situation. I never raise my voice or let me emotions control me.

backgrounds.name: Politician
backgrounds.flavorText: You might just be a Junior Representative or newly elected Senator. Regardless you are now a member of the political turmoil of the Galaxy. Depending on who you befriended, your benefactors or your sponsorships. You are now placed within a position of great power that can ultimately make decisions that could alter the course of the known Galaxy. You represent not just yourself but an entire planet that revolves around the type of difficult decisions that you will make throughout your career. Others look to you to serve as the primary legislative body of the Galactic Republic. They believe your voice is responsible for creating laws, mediating disputes, making treaties, and regulating commerce. Divided into numerous committees and subcommittees, you must choose a path. Will you strive to accomplish your goals and bring peace back to the Republic or will you like many others, fall into corruption.
backgrounds.flavorDescription:
What is the world you envision to create through policy? 

|d6|Specialization|

backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: Politicians are rumored to be wicked and blackhearted. Do you want to prove the rumors right or wrong?
backgrounds.featureText: When you walk into a room, people immediately respect your opinion and listen to what you have to say. You are commonly taken for face value as a person of great standing. People will likely treat you like a noble or assume you of that lineage. You can attain audiences with nobles or officials easily, as they may often see you as one of their circle. Bureaucratic red tape holds little challenge to you because you always seem to know the right person to talk to.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I am someone that needs no introduction, I am renowned in my own way.
I am the only one capable of making a better galaxy, I trust my gut instinct.
I'm going to take over the senate! The supreme chancellor is far to weak and foolish.
I will not tolerate violence. We are not savages, we are intellectuals.
I'm looking out only for myself here in this corrupt democracy.
I'm very patient and can conceal my inner discomforts easily.
I'm an aristocrat. I hold myself up to high standards of behavior and others just as much.
I am quiet and reserved. I will not take the spotlight from the real heroes.

idealOptions.name: Dictator
idealOptions.description: We must ensure that our authority extends to the farthest points of the galaxy. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Equality
idealOptions.description: We have elected officials for a reason, the system works we just have to give it time. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Humanity
idealOptions.description: I will serve my term with purpose, I will ensure the safety and prosperity of all of our citizens. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Rational Self Interest

idealOptions.name: Galactic Rule

I'll help, in exchange for your vote.

bondOptions.description: Children are our future. We cannot leave the galaxy like this, we cannot leave them with our mistakes.
Family, friends? Everyone is a stepping stone.
I have seen too much and have done to little, it is time for a change.
Even if I become a corrupted, I am doing it for the right reasons.

backgrounds.name: Racer

There are many places to race and many things to race with.  Maybe you dabble in all things fast.  Even still, all professional racers have a type of racing they prefer above all else; a race in which they are masters. Choose your vehicular or beastly specialty, or roll on the table below.

Because of these skills, if you know your destination and the intervening terrain--either by reputation, by sight, or by maps you have seen--you are able to identify an effective short-cut, trimming your travel time by up to half.  Your GM may rule that your short-cut entails significant danger or may be temporarily impassable.

personalityTraitOptions.description: Win or lose.  There is no try.
Giving up is never an option for me.

I don't pay attention to the risks in a situation. Never tell me the odds.

I blow up at the slightest insult.

idealOptions.name: Charity

idealOptions.name: Pride

idealOptions.name: Victory

flawOptions.description: I think most people in life are content with a participation trophy. They disgust me.
I classify everyone I meet as a winner or a loser.  There's only ever one winner.
There is not a drug I won't try.
Once I start drinking, it's hard for me to stop.
Once someone questions my courage, I never back down no matter how dangerous the situation.
Waiting around makes me antsy. I'd rather do something stupid than do nothing at all.

bondOptions.description: There is nothing more important to me than my vehicle.
I will win the Coruscant Invitational one day.
I'm trying to pay off the debt on my vehicle.
I owe a lot of money to the wrong kind of people.
I do what feels good.  Let's see the authorities catch me.
Someone I loved died because they were too slow.  That will never happen to me.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I am quiet, reserved, and focused on my work. It takes a lot for me to raise my voice or object outside of my job.
If I find an intact piece of technology, I'll be focused on how many credits I can get by salvaging it.
When I find myself in a trove full of technology, I'm thinking of a way to use them for profit.
I look down on people that do not like getting their hands dirty.
I like making friends, those who don't like widening their circle are fools.
I am polite around my customers or patrons, though I am harsh toward my fellow Scavengers.
I am slow to trust people as in my line of work; it's every individual for themselves.
If there is a lost individual that is in need, I will always lend a hand.

idealOptions.name: Honor
idealOptions.description: I don�t steal from other in or outside of the trade. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Independence
idealOptions.description: I do not work well with others, I work alone. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Charity
idealOptions.description: I use the credits I gain to help those less fortunate. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Greed
idealOptions.description: I will do whatever it takes to get more credits. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Community
idealOptions.description: I�m loyal to my friends and fellow Scavengers. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Hope
idealOptions.description: I hope to one day get enough money to start a new life in the stars. (Neutral)

flawOptions.description: When I see something valuable, I can�t think about anything but how to make a profit from it.
When faced with a choice between money and my friends, I usually choose the money.
If there�s a plan, I�ll forget it. If I don�t forget it, I�ll ignore it.
I have a "tell" that reveals when I'm lying.
I turn tail and run when things look bad.
I tend to hold people who work normal jobs in contempt.

bondOptions.description: I carry with me a unique piece of technology unknown to me, but I keep it as a good luck charm.
My fellow scavengers mean the world to me.
I unintentionally killed someone by stealing their property. I hope to redeem myself for it.
I used to work for a horrible employer that abused their power; I will take my revenge on any who bully others.
I'm working off the debt I owe to a wealthy benefactor.
Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made. That will never happen again.

backgrounds.name: Servant
backgrounds.flavorText:
You have lived much of your life in the service of a lord, noble, merchant, or someone else with much wealth or power. You fetched their coats, drove their chariots, pressed their clothes; and generally did what they asked you to do. 

Were you a highly respected butler? A simple scullery maid? Were you born into service, or did you join later? Were you close to your master or masters, or were they distant and cold? Did they treat you well, or beat you at the drop of a hat?
backgrounds.skillProficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Lore, Performance, and Persuasion
backgrounds.equipment: A noble symbol representing your employer, a set of artisan's implements (one of your choice), a set of nice clothes, a set of common clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 cr
backgrounds.suggestedCharacteristics: A servant, for better or worse, will have their personality affected by their years of servitude.
backgrounds.featureText: You know how to carry yourself around the elite and their servants. When in the presence of someone of power, or the servants of such a person, you can easily act as if you belong and, barring any extremely outlandish behavior, you can pass off your companions as belonging, too.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I am compulsively neat, and clean; I feel uncomfortable if my companions and I are ever dirty or  unpresentable.
I am a bit of a snob, and look down on the common rabble.
I am extremely subservient; I rarely raise my voice or object.
I may be quite calm and polite around those of higher power than I; but I'm harsh towards all my underlings, flexing the little power I have.
I dote over my companions like a concerned mother bird, fixing their clothing and making sure they look nice.
I hated my time as a servant, and go out of my way to enjoy myself and let loose, rarely holding my tongue.
I rarely show any emotions, remaining calm and stoic even in the worst of situations.
I can-or think I can-diffuse the most tense and stressful of situations with the right word or phrase.

idealOptions.name: Service
idealOptions.description: Your wish is my desire. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Helpful
idealOptions.description: I just enjoy making myself useful. (Light)

idealOptions.name: Free
